jei.wmd.info.airframe: Airframe, tier %s. Sets the missile's size (and so the launch pad it needs) and its health (%s, used against CIWS and interceptors later). Weighs %s. Every other part of the missile has to be of this tier or lower.

jei.wmd.info.divert: Divert motor. Set a decoy target in the launch terminal (at most 50 blocks from the real one): the missile flies to the decoy, radars and warnings expect it there, and it swerves once onto the real target. jei.wmd.info.guidance: Guidance, tier %s. The missile can miss the target by up to %s blocks. Weighs %s.
jei.wmd.info.warhead: %s warhead, tier %s. %s Weighs %s. The size of the blast belongs to the warhead; the missile body only has to be of this tier or higher.
jei.wmd.info.wh.incendiary: A small crater, then fire spreads over a wide area for 30 seconds.
jei.wmd.info.wh.frag: A small crater, but people are hurt over a very wide area.
jei.wmd.info.wh.decoy: No damage, only a harmless pop. Looks like any missile on radar and soaks up defences.
jei.wmd.info.wh.thermobaric: A fuel cloud first, then a wide, shallow blast that also blows away leaves, glass and wood.
jei.wmd.info.wh.cluster: Releases a rain of small bomblets along its approach path.
jei.wmd.info.wh.breacher: A small crater plus a deep vertical bore through roofs, floors and rock.
jei.wmd.info.wh.chaff: A smoke bank about 100 x 100 blocks wide that blinds radar for 90 seconds.
jei.wmd.info.wh.bunker: A narrow, deep hole, then a delayed blast far underground.
jei.wmd.info.wh.emp: No block damage: empties the power of machines, radars and batteries in a large field for 40 seconds.
jei.wmd.info.wh.nuke: The big one: a huge crater and a mushroom cloud.
jei.wmd.info.wh.thermo: Tier 4: a crater twice the nuke's and a bigger mushroom, then a shockwave sweeping 250 blocks that breaks every soft block: glass, leaves, wool, doors, torches, flowers.
jei.wmd.info.wh.rod: A kinetic penetrator: in its last 10 seconds the missile becomes a tungsten rod falling at hypersonic speed: death inside 30 blocks, a molten shaft 110 deep, a shockwave killing nearly everything within 300, cracks in the ground, aftershocks and a dust-dimmed sky.
jei.wmd.info.wh.hemp: High-altitude electromagnetic pulse, radius 1000: no damage, but every power store is emptied and kept empty for 5 minutes. Hardened blocks above a machine shield it.
jei.wmd.info.wh.seismic: A ground shock, then every cave roof and unsupported ceiling within 150 blocks falls in.
jei.wmd.info.missile: A finished missile. Its weight, range, speed and health depend on its parts: the motor sets the base range and speed, the weight of all parts changes the range, and the jet fuel it needs is %s mB plus %s mB per block of range. A launch pad only takes missiles of its own tier or smaller; a tier 3 pad fuels fastest.

gui.wmd.info.research: Pick a research on the left, load its samples and a blank chip
gui.wmd.research.title: Research
gui.wmd.research.pick: Pick a research above to see what it needs
gui.wmd.research.picked: Picked: the station works on this
jei.wmd.research.blank: Blank chip: used up by every research run
jei.wmd.research.unlocks: Unlocks (the chip is an ingredient of):
jei.wmd.info.chip_blank: Blank chip: an empty blueprint chip. The research station uses one up per research run and writes a finished chip onto it.
jei.wmd.info.chip_metallurgy_2: METALLURGY II chip, researched at the research station. Ingredient of: titanium chlorinator, magnesium electrolyser, carbide drill bit, titanium impeller and turbine blades (1 chip each), and the Titanium Reactor (2 chips).
jei.wmd.info.chip_mining_1: MINING I chip, researched at the research station. Ingredient of: the mining rig (2 chips).
jei.wmd.info.chip_power_2: POWER II chip, researched at the research station. Ingredient of: the gas turbine (2 chips) and the grid converter (1 chip).
jei.wmd.info.chip_rocketry_2: ROCKETRY II chip, researched at the research station. Ingredient of: the bay size kit (the calibre upgrade of the missile bay), the interceptor silo T3 and the tier 3 launch terminal (2 chips each). Research once, build every missile.
jei.wmd.info.chip_defence_2: DEFENCE II chip, researched at the research station. Ingredient of: the CIWS and the heavy interceptor battery T2 (2 chips each).
jei.wmd.info.chip_warheads_2: WARHEADS II chip, researched at the research station. The lab uses one per warhead run of the bunker buster, EMP, nuke, kinetic rod, HEMP and seismic warheads (the thermonuclear pays through its nuke).
item.wmd.field_manual.tip: Right-click: the titanium chain step by step
manual.wmd.overview.title: Crude to titanium
manual.wmd.overview.body: Turn the page for each step. A stuck machine says on its screen what to build.
manual.wmd.power.title: 1. Power first
manual.wmd.power.body: Machines take power only from busbars. Coal generator %s FE/s; steam engine %s FE/s (2x per coal, piped water); diesel %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.blast_furnace.title: 1b. Steel: the blast furnace
manual.wmd.blast_furnace.body: Burns coal (fuel slot), no power. 1 iron + %s coal (additive): steel in %s s. Fuel: 1 coal per %s jobs. 3 copper + 1 tin: 4 bronze. Blower: %sx for %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.oil.title: 2. Crude oil
manual.wmd.oil.body: Find oil with the oil detector; a pumpjack's front 3x3 (wellhead end) must be over it: %s mB every 30 s. The desalter splits off %s%% brine. Keep the brine!
manual.wmd.refinery.title: 3. Refinery and coke
manual.wmd.refinery.body: The column gives LPG, naphtha, kerosene, diesel and fuel oil. The coker turns %s mB bitumen into %s coke.
manual.wmd.deposits.title: 4. Deep ores
manual.wmd.deposits.body: Titanium (rutile), tungsten and uranium ores lie deep: y -64 to -40. Use the scanner to find one; sneak-click air: next ore. Sneak-click a deposit: core sample. Mine it: chunk.
manual.wmd.research.title: 5. Research station
manual.wmd.research.body: Tier 2 machines need blueprint chips. Pick a research, load its samples and a blank chip, give it power: it writes one chip. Recipes use chips up: make spares.
manual.wmd.chips_industry.title: Industry chips
manual.wmd.chips_industry.body: METALLURGY II: titanium chlorinator, Mg cell, Kroll (2), carbide bit, blades. MINING I: rig (2). POWER II: turbine (2), converter.
manual.wmd.chips_weapons.title: Weapon chips
manual.wmd.chips_weapons.body: ROCKETRY II: bay size kit, T3 silo, terminal 3. DEFENCE II: CIWS, T2 battery. WARHEADS II: tier 3 + HEMP, seismic.
manual.wmd.water.title: 6. Water Pump
manual.wmd.water.body: Build it on a shore, water BEHIND it. Bronze impeller: %s mB/t, titanium: %s mB/t. Under %s water sources: 10%% speed. Pipe it to the rig.
manual.wmd.heavy_water.title: 6b. Upgrades, heavy water
manual.wmd.heavy_water.body: Right-click a machine with an upgrade to fit it (4 slots, Upgrades tab). More of the same = higher level, max %s. Heavy water upgrade on the intake: %s mB water -> 1 mB heavy water; the port then gives heavy water.
manual.wmd.rig.title: 7. Mining rig
manual.wmd.rig.body: Needs 2 MINING I chips. Place it near deposits: it drills every deposit block within %s blocks of its hole, down to bedrock. Per block: %s raw ore, %s mB water. Uraninite needs the diamond bit.
manual.wmd.crusher.title: 8. Crusher
manual.wmd.crusher.body: Raw ore crushes into %s concentrate, a hand-mined chunk into %s. No rig yet? Chunks work, just slower.
manual.wmd.chlorine.title: 9. Brine Electrolysis Cell
manual.wmd.chlorine.body: Pipe in brine: %s mB gives %s mB chlorine, %s mB hydrogen and 1 caustic soda. No chip needed.
manual.wmd.chlorinator.title: 10. Titanium Chlorinator
manual.wmd.chlorinator.body: Needs 1 METALLURGY II chip. %s concentrate + %s coke + %s mB chlorine make %s mB TiCl4.
manual.wmd.magnesium.title: 11. Magnesium Electrolyser
manual.wmd.magnesium.body: 1 METALLURGY II chip. Start on brine: %s mB, 1 magnesium (slow). Then pipe in the Kroll MgCl2: %s mB, %s Mg + %s mB chlorine. A crane taps the metal.
manual.wmd.kroll.title: 12. Titanium Reactor
manual.wmd.kroll.body: Needs 2 METALLURGY II chips. %s mB TiCl4 + %s magnesium: %s sponge + %s mB MgCl2 in %s s. MgCl2 back to the Mg cell.
manual.wmd.arc.title: 13. Titanium ingots
manual.wmd.arc.body: The arc furnace melts 1 sponge into 1 titanium ingot. An electrode lasts %s melts. It also makes tungsten the slow way: %s concentrate per ingot.
manual.wmd.turbine.title: 14. Gas turbine
manual.wmd.turbine.body: Needs 2 POWER II chips. Burns LPG, gasoline or naphtha: %s FE/s. Blades wear out. NEVER stand at its intake! Grid converter: other FE in, %s%% kept.
gui.wmd.hint.mgcell_either: Needs %s mB more MgCl2 (or %s mB brine)
gui.wmd.hint.core_sample.how: Dig down to a deposit (y -64 to -40) and sneak-right-click the deposit block with the Ground Scanner
manual.wmd.plates_wires.title: Plates and wires
manual.wmd.plates_wires.body: Plates (%s a block): armour, airframes, silos, casings. Wires (%s an ingot): circuits, busbars, generators.
block.wmd.generator_engine.retired: This engine is a crafting part now: craft a Diesel Generator (casings + engine + power port) and place it
gui.wmd.info.leach_tank: %s concentrate + %s caustic soda + %s mB water -> %s yellowcake every %s s
gui.wmd.info.centrifuge: %s yellowcake -> %s enriched + %s depleted uranium every %s s
gui.wmd.hint.torpedo: Needs a torpedo (any type) or UUV
gui.wmd.hint.torpedo.how: Load it by hand, or put a torpedo rack next to it
gui.wmd.info.roaster: %s W concentrate + %s mB LPG -> %s oxide every %s s
gui.wmd.info.blast_furnace: Steel: %s iron (charge) + %s coal or 1 coke (additive) -> 1 steel every %s s, plus fuel; no power needed
gui.wmd.info.blast_furnace_smelt: Smelts anything a blast furnace or furnace does, at blast furnace speed; 1 coal per %s items
gui.wmd.info.blast_furnace_bronze: Bronze: %s copper ingots (charge) + %s tin ingot (additive) -> %s bronze every %s s, plus fuel
gui.wmd.info.blast_furnace_blower: Busbar power drives the hot-blast blower: %sx speed for %s FE/s
gui.wmd.info.hydrogen_furnace: %s oxide + %s mB hydrogen -> %s powder every %s s
gui.wmd.info.sinter_press: %s powder -> 1 ingot, or %s powder -> 1 rod, every %s s
gui.wmd.press.picked: Picked: the next press makes this
tooltip.wmd.radar_component: A phased-array module pulled from an abandoned radar station. Valuable to trade.
tooltip.wmd.guidance_core_t4: A tier 4 inertial guidance core from a decommissioned silo.
tooltip.wmd.satellite_part: Solar array and bus fragment from a crashed satellite. Needed for satellites (v0.4).
death.attack.wmd.salvage_turret: %1$s was gunned down by an abandoned turret
death.attack.wmd.salvage_turret.player: %1$s was gunned down by an abandoned turret while fighting %2$s
gui.wmd.reactor.unsafe: Above SAFE MAX: it will overheat
gui.wmd.reactor.scram_tip: All rods in at once: power 0, the heat falls
gui.wmd.hint.fuel_rod.how: Craft fuel rods: 3 enriched uranium + titanium plate + tungsten rod
message.wmd.nuclear.steam: REACTOR WARNING: steam venting at %s %s %s. Lower the rods or SCRAM!
message.wmd.nuclear.imminent: REACTOR MELTDOWN IMMINENT at %s %s %s! SCRAM now or run!
message.wmd.nuclear.meltdown: The nuclear reactor at %s %s %s has melted down!
message.wmd.nuclear.damaged: The nuclear reactor at %s %s %s overheated and shut down. It is damaged: use a reactor repair kit.
message.wmd.nuclear.repaired: Reactor repaired: pick a rod level to start it again
message.wmd.reactor_form.missing: Reactor not complete: %s cells wrong. First at %s %s %s: needs %s
gui.wmd.info.reactor_steam: Makes %s mB steam a tick at 100 %% (1 mB water each). Coolant pumps: %s FE/s. One fuel rod lasts %s min at 100 %%.
gui.wmd.info.reactor_loop: Steam -> steam turbine -> cooling tower -> water back. Steam that cannot leave = no cooling.
message.wmd.nuclear.needs_steam_ports: Reactor unformed: the steam loop needs a Reactor Steam Port at %s %s %s and in the other back corner
gui.wmd.info.steam_turbine: %s mB steam a tick -> %s FE/s + the same amount of spent steam
gui.wmd.info.steam_turbine_out: Stops when its spent steam has nowhere to go: pipe it to a cooling tower
gui.wmd.info.tower_condense: %s mB spent steam a tick -> %s mB water
gui.wmd.info.tower_dump: Takes raw steam too. No power = no condensing.
gui.wmd.info.reprocessing_plant: %s spent fuel rod + %s caustic soda + %s mB water -> %s plutonium + %s depleted uranium, %s s
gui.wmd.hint.spent_fuel.how: Run a nuclear reactor (spent rods leave through its fuel port)
jei.wmd.reactor.heat_steam: Steam that cannot leave = heat = meltdown
jei.wmd.steam_turbine.note: Spent steam goes to a cooling tower
jei.wmd.cooling_tower.note: Water back to the reactor (5 %% lost)
manual.wmd.tungsten.title: 15. Tungsten
manual.wmd.tungsten.body: Wolframite gives tungsten. The arc furnace is the slow early route: %s concentrate, 1 ingot, %s s. Enough for drill bits, engines and the next chip.
manual.wmd.chips_late.title: Late chips
manual.wmd.chips_late.body: METALLURGY III: roaster, reduction furnace, sinter press (2). NUCLEAR I: leach tank, centrifuge, reactor (%s), cooling tower, steam turbine, reprocessing plant.
manual.wmd.tungsten_chain.title: 16. Tungsten chain
manual.wmd.tungsten_chain.body: 3x the arc furnace. LPG: %s mB a run, hydrogen: %s mB. Press button: ingot (%s powder) or rod (%s powder).
manual.wmd.tungsten_parts.title: 17. Tungsten parts
manual.wmd.tungsten_parts.body: The rolling mill presses a tungsten block into %s plates. A plate on a titanium casing: the tungsten-alloy casing (tier 4) for nuclear machines.
manual.wmd.uranium.title: 18. Uranium
manual.wmd.uranium.body: Raw uranium: %s concentrate. Leach tank: %s concentrate, 1 caustic soda and %s mB water make %s yellowcake.
manual.wmd.centrifuge.title: 19. Centrifuges
manual.wmd.centrifuge.body: One column: %s s a run. Side by side: +%s%% speed per neighbour, %s%% inside a row. Craft the fuel rod by hand.
manual.wmd.reactor_parts.title: 20. Reactor parts
manual.wmd.reactor_parts.body: Controller: front middle. Fuel port: front left corner. Water ports: side middles. Steam ports: back corners. Power port: back middle.
manual.wmd.reactor_build.title: 21. Building it
manual.wmd.reactor_build.body: 9 wide, 10 high, 9 deep. Floor: plating. Centre: 3x3 core shield, 8 high, rod drives on top, pumps off its corners. Frame pillars at corners and side middles, a ring on top. Rest: AIR. Click the controller: it names the first wrong cell.
manual.wmd.reactor_run.title: 22. Reactor controls
manual.wmd.reactor_run.body: Rods 0-100%%; SCRAM drops them all in. SAFE MAX is what your cooling holds: stay under it. Coolant pumps need %s FE/s by busbar: start on batteries or a gas turbine. One rod: %s min at 100%%.
manual.wmd.steam_loop.title: 23. Steam loop
manual.wmd.steam_loop.body: A pipe carries %s mB/t: lay 2 pipes per stream. Turbine at 100%%: %s FE/s. The tower gives back all but %s%% of the water: top up with a water pump.
manual.wmd.meltdown.title: 24. Heat and meltdown
manual.wmd.meltdown.body: Heat %s: alarm. %s: steam vents, chat warning. %s: MELTDOWN IMMINENT. %s: meltdown, a small nuke. Heat comes from too little water, no pump power or blocked steam: SCRAM!
manual.wmd.plutonium.title: 25. Plutonium
manual.wmd.plutonium.body: A burnt fuel rod comes out spent. The reprocessing plant makes 1 plutonium from it in %s s. A nuke warhead needs 1, a thermonuclear 1 more.
manual.wmd.salvage.title: Salvage sites
manual.wmd.salvage.body: Radar stations, silos, crashed satellites: one per %s blocks, %s+ from spawn. Turrets fire within %s blocks: break the old generator. Loot: parts you cannot craft.
manual.wmd.contents.title: Contents
manual.wmd.contents.hint: Click a chapter. Home key: back here.
manual.wmd.launch.title: Launch pads
manual.wmd.launch.body: Wrench the terminal to form the pad. Pipe in jet fuel. Link a radar (network card) or range is 0; a nav sat replaces it. Range T1-T3: %s / %s / %s. Nuke fuse: ground or AIR (wider, no crater).
manual.wmd.t4_rocket.title: T4 rocket
manual.wmd.t4_rocket.body: Bay Build mode makes the stages: core and upper from tier 4 parts, boosters from T2-T3. The T4 terminal takes core, upper (or a payload unit) and 2 boosters. Jet fuel, or alkylate: x%s range.
manual.wmd.radar.title: Radar station
manual.wmd.radar.body: 11 x 11 x 15. SEEK: watches %s blocks for missiles, feeds interceptors and alarms on its frequency. TARGET: aims linked pads within its 180 degree arc (T1-T2 pads: turn it by hand).
manual.wmd.alarm.title: Alarms and frequency
manual.wmd.alarm.body: Radars, sirens and interceptor sites talk on a frequency (1-9999): set it in the frequency tab. A siren sounds when a radar on its frequency sees a hostile missile. Test plays it once.
manual.wmd.bay.title: Assembly bay
manual.wmd.bay.body: Place the core; its Line tab builds weld, crane and warhead cell. T2 parts add the clean room, T3 the paint tunnel, T4 the cryo. Big airframes need size kits and extensions. Modes: the buttons on the right.
manual.wmd.rack.title: Missile rack
manual.wmd.rack.body: Finished missiles roll into the racks: 6 cradles each, up to 4 racks (racks 3 and 4 need all 6 extensions). Open any rack to see all of them. Take only.
manual.wmd.lab.title: Warhead lab
manual.wmd.lab.body: Place the lab core; its Line tab builds press, filler, reactor, oven and storage in order, 5 blocks apart. Load the Build tab, press Start. At the reactor keep the gauges green! Warheads wait in storage.
manual.wmd.interceptors.title: Interceptors
manual.wmd.interceptors.body: One per tube (bay: interceptor warhead). They fire when a SEEK radar on their frequency locks a hostile missile. Reach T1-T4: %s / %s / %s / %s, +%s with an air defence console.
manual.wmd.ciws.title: CIWS and C-RAM
manual.wmd.ciws.body: Shoots missiles within %s blocks for a SEEK radar on its frequency. Needs ammo boxes and power. As C-RAM it hits shells and rockets within %s blocks without a radar: one burst each, %s%%.
manual.wmd.lock.title: Lock and owner
manual.wmd.lock.body: Whoever places a machine owns it and alone can mine it. Lock tab: PRIVATE = owner and whitelist; PUBLIC = anyone may use it. Refused strangers trip your alarm board. Command center modules use the building's lock.
manual.wmd.oil_upgrades.title: Refinery upgrades
manual.wmd.oil_upgrades.body: The FCC cracks gas oil into gasoline and LPG. The jet fuel hydrotreater makes jet fuel for the pads. Spare LPG: flare stack (power) or alkylation.
manual.wmd.aluminium_he.title: Aluminium and HE
manual.wmd.aluminium_he.body: An electrode lasts %s runs. The nitration reactor uses %s mB naphtha per HE charge: warheads, shells, rockets.
manual.wmd.alkylation.title: Alkylation unit
manual.wmd.alkylation.body: No chip needed. Pipe in LPG (%s mB/s): %s%% comes out as alkylate (Ports tab). One acid catalyst in the item hatch lasts %s mB of LPG. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.canisters.title: Alkylate canisters
manual.wmd.canisters.body: Empty canisters go into the item hatch and come back with %s mB. Uses: cruise missiles (1 a launch), super gun charges (shell press), T4 rockets (pipe alkylate into the pad: x%s range).
manual.wmd.satellites.title: Satellites
manual.wmd.satellites.body: Max %s in orbit on the server. Each passes over every spot every %s min, %s min overhead. The RTG lasts %s real days. It works only with your powered ground station and an active command center.
manual.wmd.space_chip.title: SPACE I and the RTG
manual.wmd.space_chip.body: Research SPACE I first: it unlocks the ground station, RTG cell, facility and command center. Each satellite needs an RTG cell (+ an advanced circuit).
manual.wmd.sat_facility.title: Satellite facility
manual.wmd.sat_facility.body: Pick the type, load RTG, titanium, silicon, circuits, aluminium and the module: nav clock, recon spyglass, relay gold wire, interceptor kill vehicle pack, designator laser pod. %s s, %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.sat_launch.title: Launching a satellite
manual.wmd.sat_launch.body: Payload unit in the T4 terminal's upper slot, plus core and boosters. No target or radar: it climbs %s blocks east to orbit. Refused when %s are up. Defences can shoot it.
manual.wmd.ground_station.title: Ground station
manual.wmd.ground_station.body: 5 x 7 x 5, %s FE/s. While powered it controls your satellites; its screen shows each one: type, life, next pass. The Enemy satellites list is where hacks start. The dish follows the satellite overhead.
manual.wmd.nav_sat.title: Nav satellite
manual.wmd.nav_sat.body: With a controlled nav satellite no launch needs a radar: full range, no arc limit, at the pad and from the command center. Uplink cells, guided shells and guided rockets need it too. The target designator needs it.
manual.wmd.uplink.title: Uplink cell
manual.wmd.uplink.body: Bay uplink slot. With nav coverage: half the miss radius, one retarget or player lock (retarget console), homing onto an enemy machine within %s blocks in the last %s s. Chaff cannot fool it.
manual.wmd.recon_sat.title: Recon satellite
manual.wmd.recon_sat.body: Warning board: every enemy launch on the server (impact +-%s). Air defence console: space tracks for your interceptors. Recon wall: pictures of your recon target while overhead.
manual.wmd.recon_map.title: Recon map
manual.wmd.recon_map.body: Open it from the recon wall. Target X Z = a %s block square, retaken every %s s during a pass, with players and missiles. Click a spot, then Designate. The fill maps the rest of the square slowly.
manual.wmd.cubesat.title: CubeSat
manual.wmd.cubesat.body: CubeSat warhead (warhead lab) on a T3 missile: from your own terminal it climbs to orbit, no target. For %s min it stays over your recon target. Outside the orbit cap; needs only the command center.
manual.wmd.recon_drone.title: Recon drone
manual.wmd.recon_drone.body: Right-click: flies to the designated target or the block you look at (max %s). Maps the area for %s s, then lands home as an item. Max 2 each. Radars see it; CIWS and interceptors shoot it.
manual.wmd.early_warning.title: Early-warning array
manual.wmd.early_warning.body: 15 x 18 x 9, no chip. While powered it warns you of every launch within %s blocks: chat, warning boards, battle log, DEFCON. No satellite needed. %s FE/s. Its screen lists the last 5 launches.
manual.wmd.asat.title: ASAT
manual.wmd.asat.body: Tier 4 warhead for the upper stage. Pick an enemy satellite (terminal ASAT button or console 'Sat >') and launch while it is overhead, ground station powered. %s s later: %s%% hit.
manual.wmd.hacking.title: Hacking
manual.wmd.hacking.body: Ground station: Enemy satellites, Hack. Needs an online EW rack and the satellite overhead: %s s at %s more FE/s, then it is yours. One try a pass. The owner can RE-KEY on the globe (%s min cooldown).
manual.wmd.interceptor_sat.title: Interceptor satellite
manual.wmd.interceptor_sat.body: Once per pass it shoots an enemy missile launched under it: %s%% kill. ENGAGE on its console: ANY, or OWN = aimed within %s blocks of your command center. Satellite launches are spared.
manual.wmd.cc_building.title: Command center
manual.wmd.cc_building.body: 19 x 10 x 19, placed on a clear box. Busbar into its socket: %s FE/s plus the modules. Put module items in its slots: each appears at its spot in the hall. Door: right-click or redstone.
manual.wmd.cc_reach.title: Reach
manual.wmd.cc_reach.body: Consoles order pads, guns and missiles within %s blocks of your active command center. With the comms array on the roof and a controlled relay satellite the reach is the whole world.
manual.wmd.cc_map_table.title: Command table
manual.wmd.cc_map_table.body: The hologram shows your area (HOME) or the recon picture (RECON) with assets, missiles and warnings. Overview tab: modules and the designated target: type X Z and Mark. Every console can use that target.
manual.wmd.defcon.title: DEFCON
manual.wmd.defcon.body: DEFCON tab of the map table. 4: team banner on incoming. 3: interceptor sats engage ANY; alarms lock down. 2: door seals for impacts within %s blocks. 1: red alert, launch site designated, counter-strike armed %s s.
manual.wmd.battle_log.title: Battle log
manual.wmd.battle_log.body: Keeps your last 64 events: launches, interceptions, hits, hacks, alarms, DEFCON. Read it in the map table LOG tab (scroll). The map printer prints it as a book.
manual.wmd.cc_warning_board.title: Warning board
manual.wmd.cc_warning_board.body: Incoming missiles (recon satellite or array): track, impact, time left. Click a row, then Designate source. The mode button shows OUTBOUND: your own. Bottom-middle block: redstone on alert.
manual.wmd.cc_recon_wall.title: Recon wall
manual.wmd.cc_recon_wall.body: Shows your recon picture, live while the satellite is overhead, and opens the recon map. During a missile cam watch it shows the live track. It alternates with damage reports.
manual.wmd.damage.title: Damage reports
manual.wmd.damage.body: A hit inside your recon square makes a report: before and after pictures, machines destroyed (after = the next pass). On the recon wall, the recon map's Damage panel and printed maps.
manual.wmd.cc_air_defence.title: Air defence console
manual.wmd.cc_air_defence.body: Lists your interceptor sites. While online, every launcher, battery and silo of yours reaches %s blocks farther and gets the recon satellite's space tracks. CIWS range stays.
manual.wmd.cc_launch.title: Launch console
manual.wmd.cc_launch.body: Pick a pad or cruise launcher in reach, type X Z (or Recon / Use target), press Aim, then LAUNCH twice. Pads aim their radar themselves. ASAT: "Sat >" picks the enemy satellite.
manual.wmd.cc_retarget.title: Retarget console
manual.wmd.cc_retarget.body: Lists your uplinked missiles in flight. Give one a new target once, or lock it on a player. Needs nav coverage; an enemy EW rack can jam it.
manual.wmd.cc_strike.title: Strike planner
manual.wmd.cc_strike.body: Tick 1-8 pads plus guns and cruise launchers: all hit at the same second. Counter = every ready pad on the designated source. Package = your recon targets by priority, one pad each.
manual.wmd.cc_cam.title: Missile cam
manual.wmd.cc_cam.body: Fit a cam pod in the bay's camera slot (T4: when the upper stage is built). Watch rides the missile to impact; on a pad row it arms and starts at lift-off. ESC or sneak to leave.
manual.wmd.cc_globe.title: Satellite globe
manual.wmd.cc_globe.body: Your satellites on a globe with their orbits. Sets the recon target, DEORBIT (press twice) and RE-KEY: stops any hack on it, then waits %s min.
manual.wmd.cc_ew_gps.title: EW and GPS racks
manual.wmd.cc_ew_gps.body: EW rack: your ground station jams enemy uplinked missiles aimed within %s blocks; needed to hack. GPS rack: a minimap for you and your whitelist, and the target designator (sneak + right-click).
manual.wmd.cc_alarm.title: Alarm board
manual.wmd.cc_alarm.body: Logs strangers using or mining your machines, craters and explosions: chat, lamps, redstone. Lockdown on: any alarm seals the door for %s s (always at DEFCON 3 and below).
manual.wmd.cc_printer.title: Map printer
manual.wmd.cc_printer.body: Prints the recon picture on an empty map, with every enemy machine listed. Modes: recon map, damage report, battle log (a book).
manual.wmd.cc_comms.title: Comms array
manual.wmd.cc_comms.body: Stands on the building's roof pad. With a controlled relay satellite your consoles reach the whole world.
manual.wmd.mortar.title: Mortar
manual.wmd.mortar.body: Tier 1, 2 x 2 x 2, no power, no chip. %s-%s blocks, high angle, a round every %s s. Shells go in on any side; %s of each type. Type X Z or take the command center target, pick the shell, Fire.
manual.wmd.howitzer.title: Field howitzer
manual.wmd.howitzer.body: Tier 2, 3 x 3 x 5, %s-%s blocks. Charge k of %s reaches k fifths of the range and burns k propellant charges (AUTO picks). %s FE/s while working. Shells and charges via the item hatch.
manual.wmd.shell_press.title: Shell press
manual.wmd.shell_press.body: Pick a recipe in the left panel (pages at the bottom): casing, filler, fuze. %s s a batch at %s FE/s. Makes all shells, charges, super gun ammo and rocket pods. No chip.
manual.wmd.shells.title: Shell types
manual.wmd.shells.body: HE: crater. Smoke: a screen for %s s. Illumination: a flare for %s s. Cluster: %s bursts. Spread grows with range; a SPOTTED target (recon picture, designator mark or drone) cuts it to %s%%.
manual.wmd.guided.title: Guided ammo
manual.wmd.guided.body: Shell press: HE ammo plus a T1 guidance. With your controlled nav satellite guided shells land within %s block, guided rockets within %s. Without one they spread like HE.
manual.wmd.counter_battery.title: Counter-battery radar
manual.wmd.counter_battery.body: Sees enemy shells within %s blocks and traces each to its gun (within %s blocks): warning board, designated target, battle log. At DEFCON 1 your idle guns fire back by themselves. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.art_console.title: Artillery console
manual.wmd.art_console.body: Tick 1-8 guns in reach, give X Z, a recon icon or the designated target, pick type, rounds and charge, press FIRE twice. Types a gun cannot fire are greyed. Cease stops them.
manual.wmd.iron_dome.title: Iron Dome
manual.wmd.iron_dome.body: Set a centre and radius (%s-%s): 8 markers appear. A powered, loaded CIWS with a SEEK radar within %s blocks of each = DOME ON: shared targets, %s%% hits. One missing = DOME DOWN.
manual.wmd.mlrs.title: M270 rocket launcher
manual.wmd.mlrs.body: Tier 3, %s-%s blocks. Two pods = a 12 rocket salvo that saturates a disc. With a pod empty it reloads from its magazine (%s s). HE and guided pods go in through the item hatch. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.super_gun.title: Super gun
manual.wmd.super_gun.body: Tier 4, 9 x 9 x 21. %s-%s blocks, one shot every %s min, a missile-size HE blast that cannot be intercepted. AUTO picks the charges. Enemy warning boards within %s blocks see SUPER GUN.
manual.wmd.camo.title: Camo net
manual.wmd.camo.body: Place it against a machine (up to %s x %s): enemy recon sees green net, no icon. Radars still see launches. Any blast nearby tears it: then it hides nothing until replaced. Anyone can break it.
manual.wmd.decoys.title: Decoys
manual.wmd.decoys.body: Inflatable fakes: enemy recon sees a launch site or a radar. They inflate in 5 s and last %s h. Any blast nearby pops them.
manual.wmd.cruise_missile.title: Cruise missile
manual.wmd.cruise_missile.body: Bay mode Cruise: T2-T3 airframe, jet engine, guidance, ground-attack warhead. Route range %s (T2) / %s (T3). Flies %s blocks above ground; radars see it within %s blocks only. No uplink.
manual.wmd.cruise_launcher.title: Cruise launcher
manual.wmd.cruise_launcher.body: 4 missiles, 1 alkylate canister per launch. Set up to %s waypoints and the target (or CC tgt): the route must be %s+ blocks and in range. Fire 1, Salvo or Abort. The command center can fire it too.
manual.wmd.ghost.title: Ghost preview
manual.wmd.ghost.body: Hold a machine item and aim: the outline shows where it goes, red cubes where blocked, the front in blue, ports marked. Port overlay (config): a pipe, busbar or wrench in hand marks nearby ports.
manual.wmd.wrench.title: Wrench
manual.wmd.wrench.body: Right-click a one-block machine: turns it 90 degrees (sneak: the other way). Multiblocks cannot turn. On a launch terminal it forms the pad, on a radar station it unforms it.
manual.wmd.load_all.title: Load all
manual.wmd.load_all.body: Guns, launchers, the cruise launcher, shell press, alkylation unit and coal generator have a Load all button: it moves what fits from your inventory. The press loads whole batches of the picked recipe.
manual.wmd.config_client.title: Client settings
manual.wmd.config_client.body: Mods, WMD, Config: camera shake, far boom volume, hologram detail, dome pillars, trail distance, missile cam HUD, strike card, ghost preview, port overlay.
manual.wmd.config_server.title: Server settings
manual.wmd.config_server.body: Per world (operators): block damage, largest crater, protected spawn radius, nukes and single warheads on or off, super gun on or off, shells in the air, impact chunk loading, recon fill speed.
manual.wmd.strike_toast.title: Strike result
manual.wmd.strike_toast.body: When everything of one strike has landed (a launch, a salvo, a fire mission or a planned strike) a card slides in on the right: missiles, rounds, hits, intercepted, damage reports. Switch it off in the client settings.

manual.wmd.airships.title: Airships on radar
manual.wmd.airships.body: Ships of 350+ blocks show on a SEEKING radar: red hostile, grey neutral, blue friendly. Hostile = foreign WMD machine or player aboard. Click a row to target it (again to clear), or /airship target.
manual.wmd.ship_defence.title: Shooting airships
manual.wmd.ship_defence.body: Hostile or targeted ships take CIWS fire (%s blocks a burst, stone or softer), interceptor blasts and any shot crossing them. Uplinked missiles home on a targeted ship. Armour resists CIWS.
wmd.configuration.debrisMaxLive: Debris pieces at once per dimension
wmd.configuration.debrisHurts: Flying debris hurts players and mobs

wmd.configuration.blueMapAdminLayer: BlueMap layer B: admin (all machines, flights)
wmd.configuration.blueMapWarLayer: BlueMap layer C: open war map
wmd.configuration.blueMapHistorySize: BlueMap: craters kept in the history
message.wmd.place.claimed: This would reach into land claimed by someone else (at %s, %s, %s). Build it further away or inside your own claim.
message.wmd.thermal.none: Thermal net: no machine on a side of it (up to %1$s x %1$s blocks)
message.wmd.thermal.too_big: Thermal net: that machine is too big (up to %1$s x %1$s blocks)
message.wmd.thermal.covering: Thermal net: covering the %s (%s x %s): hidden from recon and heat seekers
message.wmd.thermal.torn: Thermal net: TORN over the %s (%s x %s): it hides nothing; break it and place it again
message.wmd.smoke.no_canister: Smoke machine: no smoke canister loaded
message.wmd.smoke.no_power: Smoke machine: not enough power for a launch
message.wmd.smoke.emp: Smoke machine: dead in the EMP field
gui.wmd.smoke.info_cloud: Cloud: %s blocks round it, full in %s s, lasts %s s
manual.wmd.counters.title: 7c. Counters
manual.wmd.counters.body: Thermal net: hides a machine up to %s x %s from recon + heat seekers. Smoke: %s blocks, full in %s s, lasts %s s; cuts lasers. Decoy radar lures ARM missiles.
jei.wmd.info.thermal_net: Place it next to a machine up to %s x %s blocks: it hides it from enemy recon AND heat seekers. A blast nearby tears it.
jei.wmd.info.smoke_machine: Press LAUNCH SMOKE in its screen (manual only): a smoke cloud %s blocks round it fills in %s s and lasts %s s. It cuts laser beams, hides hot machines from heat seekers, and missiles locked inside lose their guidance. 1 canister per launch, reload %s s.
jei.wmd.info.smoke_canister: The ammunition of the smoke screen machine: one per launch.
message.wmd.pad_not_level_hold: Countdown held: the pad tilted more than %s° off level. Level the ship and launch again.
message.wmd.ship_not_level: This airship is tilted %s°: place machines on top of its deck (they stand on the deck and follow its slope), not against a side.
message.wmd.camo.not_floor: Net: mounted on a wall / ceiling: it only drapes a canopy when placed on a floor next to a machine
tooltip.wmd.laser_designator_pod: The designator satellite's laser turret: put it in the satellite facility (type Designator).
tooltip.wmd.satellite.designator: Designator: lights a laser spot from orbit while it passes over the target (aim it from the map table, Sat tab). Laser-guided payloads of any tier follow it.
gui.wmd.desig.title: Satellite designation
gui.wmd.desig.hint: Click: lase. Drag: turn. Wheel: zoom
message.wmd.desig.no_sat: That designator satellite is not yours or not in orbit
message.wmd.area.no_sat: You have no designator satellite in orbit
message.wmd.area.not_overhead: No satellite of yours is over here now
manual.wmd.designator.title: 7d. Designator satellite
manual.wmd.designator.body: Map table, Sat tab: click the 3D view to lase from orbit while it passes over (%s s every %s min). Laser payloads of any tier follow the spot.
tooltip.wmd.part.hypersonic: Scramjet: x3 speed on a low flat path; only the CIWS can hit it. Needs the laser seeker module and your lit laser spot at launch (tripod, or the designator satellite)
message.wmd.hyper.need_seeker: Hypersonic missile: it needs the LASER SEEKER module
message.wmd.hyper.need_spot: Hypersonic missile: light your laser spot within %s blocks of the target first (tripod or designator satellite)
message.wmd.hyper.need_sat: Hypersonic T4: only your DESIGNATOR SATELLITE's spot (within %s blocks of the target) can guide it
manual.wmd.hypersonic.title: 7e. Hypersonic thruster
manual.wmd.hypersonic.body: T3 motor, x%s speed, flat. Needs the laser seeker + your spot within %s blocks (T4: satellite). Only the CIWS hits it; seen %s s before impact.
tooltip.wmd.seeker.tv: TV guidance: in the dive YOU steer it through its camera (key V, or WATCH on the CC missile cam), dragging the aim inside a narrowing circle. On a cruise missile: its camera only.
key.wmd.place_turn: Turn the WMD block you are placing
message.wmd.wrench.turn_blocked: It cannot turn here: a block, someone standing there or a claim is in the way
message.wmd.place_turn.way: Placement: way %s of %s, %s, front %s (R: next, sneak + R: back)
message.wmd.tv.none: No TV missile of yours in the air
gui.wmd.tv.steer: TV: hold the left mouse button to steer (inside the blue circle)
gui.wmd.tv.wait: TV: steering opens in the dive
manual.wmd.tv.title: 7b. TV guidance
manual.wmd.tv.body: TV module: key V (or WATCH) = its camera. In the dive hold left mouse to drag the aim (%s degree circle). On a cruise missile: camera only.
tooltip.wmd.bomb.light: Light bomb: light rack, bomb bay, T3 drones
tooltip.wmd.bomb.heavy: Heavy bomb: bomb bay and T4 drones only
tooltip.wmd.bomb_iron: Dumb: falls where it falls and scatters
tooltip.wmd.bomb_laser: Homes on your laser spot within 200 blocks: zero miss
tooltip.wmd.bomb_glide: Glides up to 1,000 blocks to its rack's target
tooltip.wmd.bomb_cluster: Opens 40 blocks up: a strip of bomblets, some stay live
tooltip.wmd.bomb_delayed: Digs in, goes off 30-60 s later; a wrench defuses it
tooltip.wmd.bomb_napalm: Tumbles; a 40-block fire wave that water cannot put out
tooltip.wmd.bomb_penetrator: Bores 30 deep through armour, then a contained blast
tooltip.wmd.bomb_daisy: Goes off on its probe: flattens everything soft to 100
tooltip.wmd.bomb_tallboy: Buries itself, then the ground caves in: a 25-block sinkhole
tooltip.wmd.bomb_bouncing: Drop it low over water: it skips, sinks at the wall, breaches it
gui.wmd.sight.info_use: Uses %s FE/s while on; racks within %s
gui.wmd.sight.info_out: CCRP: a redstone pulse at the release point
manual.wmd.heavy_bombs.title: 7e. Heavy bombs
manual.wmd.heavy_bombs.body: The bay takes 2 heavy bombs (left + right row) or light ones. Delayed: wrench defuses. Bouncing: drop low over water.
manual.wmd.bomb_sight.title: 7f. Bomb sight
manual.wmd.bomb_sight.body: Hang it near your racks (%s blocks). CCIP shows where a bomb lands now; CCRP pulses redstone at the release point. At the sight: N picks a station (rack / bay row), B drops, Shift+B salvo.
message.wmd.bomb.hit: %s went off at %s %s %s (%s blocks from the drop)
message.wmd.bomb.shot_down: Your %s was shot down by a CIWS at %s %s %s (it went off in the air)
message.wmd.rack.upright: Bomb rack: hang it under a deck or on a wall (standing on a floor it cannot drop)
message.wmd.rack.no_power: Bomb rack: not enough power for a drop
message.wmd.rack.emp: Bomb rack: jammed by an EMP
manual.wmd.bombs.title: 7d. Bombs
manual.wmd.bombs.body: Hang a rack or bay under a deck. Redstone pulse drops 1, held %s ticks drops all. Laser bombs: your spot within %s. Glide: %s to the target.
tooltip.wmd.hand.manpads: Anti-air: airships, drones and cruise missiles within %s blocks (jets: only from behind, by their engine heat)
tooltip.wmd.hand.javelin: Top attack: players, big mobs and machines in sight within %s blocks
tooltip.wmd.hand.use: Hold right-click to lock on, release to fire. Uses one %s
manual.wmd.hand.title: 7c. Hand launchers
manual.wmd.hand.body: Hold right-click on a target %s s to lock, release to fire. MANPADS: air within %s (jets: from the tail). Javelin: players, big mobs, machines within %s. Smoke breaks it.
item.wmd.drone_t2.tip: Quad with a gimbal camera and its own HE charge
item.wmd.drone_t3.tip: Fixed wing, 4 x 3 blocks: carries 2 light bombs
item.wmd.drone_t4.tip: Reaper style, 10 x 6 blocks: heavy bombs, laser pod, datalink
item.wmd.drone.tip.shelf: Made on the drone line, kept on its storage shelves
item.wmd.drone.tip.hangar: Made on the drone line, parked in its hangar
item.wmd.drone.tip.later: T1 / T2 fly from the drone hive, T3 from the catapult rail, T4 from the hangar's runway
gui.wmd.drone_line.auto.tip1: Auto: start the next drone by itself
gui.wmd.drone_line.auto.tip2: whenever materials, power and space allow
gui.wmd.drone_line.sock.tip.core: The core starts the row: it is placed on the ground
gui.wmd.drone_line.line.order: Order: frame, avionics, propulsion, test, storage, hangar
gui.wmd.drone_line.line.hangar: The hangar (11 wide) is only needed for T3 / T4
gui.wmd.drone_line.store.hint: Take-only: T1 / T2 on the shelves, T3 / T4 in the hangar
message.wmd.drone_line.no_core: This module is not part of a drone line (no core)
message.wmd.drone_line.use_line_tab: Build this module from the Line tab of the drone line core
message.wmd.drone_line.cannot.2: The row is not complete (T3 / T4 also need the hangar)
message.wmd.drone_line.aborted: Drone line stopped: a module is missing (run lost)
manual.wmd.drone_line.title: 7g. Drone assembly line
manual.wmd.drone_line.body: Place the core, build the rest from its Line tab. A T1 takes %s s, a T4 %s s. Storage: %s quads; T3 / T4 go to the hangar.
gui.wmd.bomb_line.auto.tip1: Auto: start the next bomb by itself
gui.wmd.bomb_line.auto.tip2: whenever materials, power and space allow
gui.wmd.bomb_line.sock.tip.core: The core starts the row: it is placed on the ground
gui.wmd.bomb_line.line.order: Order: press, filling, fuze + fins, storage, cradle
gui.wmd.bomb_line.line.hangar: The heavy cradle (8 wide) is only for heavy bombs
gui.wmd.bomb_line.store.hint: Take-only: light bombs on pallets, a heavy one on the cradle
message.wmd.bomb_line.no_core: This module is not part of a bomb line (no core)
message.wmd.bomb_line.use_line_tab: Build this module from the Line tab of the bomb line core
message.wmd.bomb_line.cannot.2: The row is not complete (heavy bombs also need the cradle)
message.wmd.bomb_line.cannot.3: No free pallet place / the cradle is taken
message.wmd.bomb_line.cannot.6: Not enough naphtha in the filling station
message.wmd.bomb_line.aborted: Bomb line stopped: a module is missing (run lost)
manual.wmd.bomb_line.title: 7h. Bomb assembly line
manual.wmd.bomb_line.body: Bombs are made here only. Light ones from %s s, heavy up to %s s (finished on the cradle). Napalm takes %s mB naphtha piped in.
gui.wmd.hive.state.empty: Put a T1 or T2 drone in
message.wmd.tablet.bound_hive: Tablet bound to the drone hive at %s
message.wmd.tablet.no_hive: No drone hive bound: sneak + use the tablet on one
message.wmd.tablet.hive_far: The bound drone hive is too far away
message.wmd.tablet.hive_gone: The bound drone hive is not there (or not loaded)
message.wmd.hive.overworld: Hive drones fly in the overworld only (for now)
message.wmd.hive.jammed: Jammed: an EMP field is on the hive
message.wmd.hive_drone.lost: Your drone #%s was shot down near %s %s (%s)
message.wmd.hive_drone.battery: Hive drone #%s: battery empty, it fell
message.wmd.hive_drone.home: Hive drone #%s: battery low, flying home
message.wmd.hive_drone.no_target: Hive drone #%s: no target in range, flying home
message.wmd.hive_drone.signal: Signal lost: the drone flies home
message.wmd.hive_drone.docked: Hive drone #%s is back in its bay
hud.wmd.drone.enter: Flying the drone (your body stays here): WASD, Space / Sneak, Sprint = boost, left click = detonate, right click = let go
hud.wmd.drone.hint: LMB detonate  -  RMB let go  -  WASD / Space / Sneak fly  -  Sprint boost  -  scroll zoom
manual.wmd.drone_hive.title: 7i. Drone hive (T1 / T2)
manual.wmd.drone_hive.body: Put T1 / T2 drones in its bays, power it. T1 hunts within %s, T2 strikes within %s or you fly it (Mode: Fly). Tablet: sneak-use it on the hive.
message.wmd.big_drone.no_cc: T3 / T4 missions need an active command center
message.wmd.big_drone.limit: Already %s %s drones in the air (2 per active command center)
message.wmd.big_drone.no_runway: No runway: %s x %s runway tiles straight out from the hangar door
message.wmd.big_drone.too_far: The target is out of range (%s blocks)
message.wmd.big_drone.not_flying: No drone of this site is in the air
message.wmd.big_drone.watched: Someone is already watching this drone
message.wmd.big_drone.recovered: Drone #%s is down on its parachute and back on the rail
message.wmd.big_drone.landed: Drone #%s has landed and taxied into the hangar
gui.wmd.big_drone.need_target: Type the target X and Z first
gui.wmd.big_drone.st.6: T3s start from a catapult rail
gui.wmd.big_drone.runway_no: - runway: 12 x 48 tiles from the door
hud.wmd.drone.watch_hint: Watching: mouse to look  -  scroll to zoom  -  LMB move the laser (T4)  -  RMB leave
manual.wmd.big_drone.title: 7j. Drones T3 / T4
manual.wmd.big_drone.body: T3: catapult rail, 2 light bombs, range %s. T4: hangar + runway (12 x 48 tiles), 4 pylons, lases its target, range %s. Needs a command center.
manual.wmd.cc_drones.title: 7k. CC: drones + intel
manual.wmd.cc_drones.body: Map table UAV tab: your drones (recall, watch), catapults / hangars (launch, route chart). Boards warn of hostile drones within %s.

gui.wmd.chart.hint_target: Click: target  -  drag: move  -  right click: delete  -  wheel: zoom  -  right drag: pan
message.wmd.big_drone.lase_wait: The laser moves once the drone circles its target
message.wmd.big_drone.lase_far: Too far from the target (%s blocks)
message.wmd.tablet.bound_site: Tablet bound to the drone base at %s
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.laser: Aims at your laser dot (its real height; lobs high when close; from 40 blocks), else like HE
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.canister: Direct fire, 16 to 96 blocks: a cone of 40 flechettes
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.sensor: Bursts high over the aim: 2 charges strike war machines that fired lately
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.pierce: Bores through hardened blocks before it goes off
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.incendiary: Fire field + thermite that burns 2 blocks down
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.flak: Bursts near hostile drones, airships and bombs on its arc; else 30 blocks over the point you aim at (aim under their path)
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.camera: A camera on a chute: a live 3D view of the target for 30 s
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.jamming: A chaff cloud over the aim: radars cannot see through it
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.rocket: Rocket motor: 1.5 x the range, more spread
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.leaflet: Scatters your message over 64 blocks (typed on the shell press)
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.nuke: A tactical nuke for the super gun (tier 3 blast)
tooltip.wmd.art_shell_gun.rack: Fits the field howitzer's special rack
gui.wmd.art.special_empty: Special rack slot %s: empty (any special shell)
message.wmd.sensor.none: Sensor-fused shell: no hot war machine found
message.wmd.leaflet.title: LEAFLETS
message.wmd.camera.down: Camera down at %s %s: click to watch (%s s)
message.wmd.camera.none: No camera of yours is down
gui.wmd.camera.title: Camera shell view
message.wmd.cc.strike.jam_first: Jam first: a howitzer will cover the target with chaff 20 s before the impact
message.wmd.cc.strike.jam_none: Jam first: no idle howitzer with a jamming shell can reach it in time
manual.wmd.special_shells.title: 5k. Special howitzer shells
manual.wmd.special_shells.body: Load any 3 special shells in the howitzer's Special rack and pick one. Canister: direct fire %s to %s. Rocket: x1.5 range.
jei.wmd.info.wh.neutron: Kills every living thing in a big radius, through walls; the buildings stay standing.
jei.wmd.info.wh.flash: Blinds every player who can see the burst for a minute. Non-lethal.
jei.wmd.info.wh.concussion: A huge shockwave throws players and loose things far, breaks glass out to 200 blocks and leaves everyone dizzy for 2 minutes.
jei.wmd.info.wh.chemical: A lingering gas cloud that drifts with the wind for 3 minutes. A gas mask protects you.
item.wmd.gas_mask.tip: Wear it on your head: chemical gas does nothing to you while the filter lasts
item.wmd.gas_mask.filter: Filter: %s / %s s of gas (charcoal on an anvil = a new filter)
manual.wmd.chem_warheads.title: 4m. Gas + new warheads
manual.wmd.chem_warheads.body: Lab warheads. Neutron kills all life in reach, blocks stand. Flash blinds who sees it. Gas drifts %s min; a gas mask saves you.
jei.wmd.drone_line.line: Line: core, frame jig, avionics bench, propulsion station, test cell, storage / hangar
jei.wmd.drone_line.small: T1 / T2 go onto the storage shelves (%s)
jei.wmd.drone_line.big: T3 / T4 go to the drone hangar at the end of the line
jei.wmd.bomb_line.line: Line: core, casing press, filling station, fuze + fins station, storage
jei.wmd.bomb_line.light: Light bomb: stacked on the storage pallets
jei.wmd.bomb_line.heavy: Heavy bomb: finished on the heavy bomb cradle
jei.wmd.info.motor_hypersonic: Tier 3 hypersonic motor: x%s the speed on a flat path. Needs the laser seeker and your laser spot within %s blocks (tier 4: a satellite). Only the CIWS can hit it; radars warn %s s before impact.
jei.wmd.info.tv_module: Guidance module (one per missile). Press V (or WATCH) to see through the missile's camera; in its dive hold the left mouse button to drag the aim within a %s degree circle. On a cruise missile it is a camera only.
jei.wmd.info.manpads_launcher: Shoulder-fired anti-air missile. Hold right-click on an air target for %s s to lock, release to fire. Range %s blocks. Smoke breaks the lock.
jei.wmd.info.javelin_launcher: Shoulder-fired anti-armour missile. Hold right-click on a player, a big mob or a machine for %s s to lock, release to fire. Range %s blocks. Smoke breaks the lock.
jei.wmd.info.bomb_rack: Light bomb rack. Hang it under a deck (a Sable ship works). A redstone pulse drops one bomb, a signal held %s ticks drops them all. A bomb sight nearby aims for you.
jei.wmd.info.bomb_bay: Heavy bomb bay with doors: heavy bombs (left + right row) or light ones. Redstone like the rack (a pulse drops one, held %s ticks drops all); the doors open before the first drop.
jei.wmd.info.bomb_sight: Hang it within %s blocks of your racks / bays. CCIP shows where a bomb lands now; CCRP leads you onto a target (coordinates or your laser spot) and pulses redstone at the release point.
jei.wmd.info.bomb: Made only on the bomb assembly line. The explosion is the bomb's own type; the casing never changes it.
jei.wmd.info.drone_t1: Hunter quad (T1). From a drone hive it hunts within %s blocks with its small gun. %s s of battery, recharged in the hive.
jei.wmd.info.drone_t2: Strike quad (T2). From a drone hive it flies to a target within %s blocks and dives on it with its own HE charge, or you fly it (hive Mode: Fly). %s s of battery.
jei.wmd.info.drone_t3: Fixed-wing drone (T3). Thrown from the drone catapult with up to %s light bombs, range %s blocks; it comes home on a parachute beside its catapult. Needs a command center.
jei.wmd.info.drone_t4: Jet drone (T4). Based in the drone hangar, takes off from a %s x %s runway, %s pylons (heavy bombs on the inner two), lases its own target, range %s blocks. Needs a command center.
jei.wmd.info.drone_hive: Home of %s T1 / T2 drones: charges them (needs power) and launches them on a target from its screen or the laser tablet (sneak-use the tablet on the hive).
jei.wmd.info.drone_catapult: Launch rail of a T3 drone (or a T4 without a runway): load the drone and up to %s light bombs, set the mission, launch. Works on a Sable ship too.
jei.wmd.info.drone_hangar: The end of the drone line: T3 / T4 drones are parked here. Also the T4's base: its pylons, the mission and the runway out of its door (%s x %s runway tiles).
jei.wmd.info.runway_tile: Runway for the T4 drone: a strip %s wide and %s long straight out of the hangar door, at the hangar's floor level.
jei.wmd.info.gas_mask: Worn on the head: the chemical warhead's gas does nothing to you while the filter lasts (%s s of gas). Repair it with charcoal on an anvil (a new filter).
message.wmd.sight.no_racks: No bomb racks within %s blocks of the sight
message.wmd.sight.busy: That rack is still dropping another row
message.wmd.uplink.lock_lost: Flight #%s: uplink lock lost, its seeker takes over
message.wmd.uplink.hyper_lock: Flight #%s is hypersonic: it follows your laser spot only, no player or airship lock
gui.wmd.cc.b.retarget_hint_seeker: A lock overrides its seeker; the seeker takes over if the lock is lost
gui.wmd.cc.b.retarget_hint_hyper: Hypersonic: new X / Z only, it follows your laser
gui.wmd.hint.deuterium.how: Heavy water into a brine electrolysis cell: its hydrogen port gives deuterium
gui.wmd.hint.tritium.how: Irradiated breeder rods into a reprocessing plant: its tritium port gives tritium
gui.wmd.info.fusion_out: Up to %s FE/t through three busbar sockets (back)
gui.wmd.info.fusion_start: START pulls a %s FE ignition charge in through the sockets
gui.wmd.fusion.charge_how: Pulled in through the busbar sockets while ENERGISING: batteries charge it fastest
gui.wmd.fusion.throttle_tip: Output target, 10 to 100%%: the plasma follows it slowly
gui.wmd.fusion.throttle_use: At this throttle: %s D + %s T + %s water mB/s
gui.wmd.fusion.start_tip: Needs %s mB water and %s mB of each fuel; then cool-down, the ignition charge, ignition and a 2 minute ramp
gui.wmd.fusion.stop_tip: Ramps the plasma down safely (energising: stops, the charge is kept)
gui.wmd.fusion.wait_charge: Waiting for the ignition charge from the busbar sockets
manual.wmd.fusion.title: 8a. Fusion reactor
manual.wmd.fusion.body: Up to %s FE/s into busbars. START pulls a %s FE charge in through its 3 sockets, then a %s s ramp. Start: %s mB water + %s mB of each fuel. No water / fuel or an EMP: QUENCH.
gui.wmd.info.cell_heavy: Heavy water in the brine port: %s mB -> %s mB deuterium out of the hydrogen port
gui.wmd.info.mgcell_lithium: Brine also gives 1 lithium dust every %s cycles
gui.wmd.hint.breeder.how: Craft breeder rods: 4 lithium dust + tungsten rod + titanium plate
jei.wmd.note.cell_heavy: Heavy water instead of brine (same port); the gas port must be free of hydrogen
jei.wmd.info.fusion_reactor: The 17 x 13 x 17 tokamak (v0.8). Up to %s FE/s straight into busbars from its 3 back sockets. START pulls a %s FE ignition charge IN through the same sockets, then a %s s ramp. Fuel: deuterium + tritium + cooling water. Out of any of them, or an EMP: QUENCH.
jei.wmd.info.lithium_dust: From brine in the magnesium electrolyser: 1 dust every %s brine cycles. 4 make a breeder rod.
jei.wmd.info.breeder_rod: Put it in a fission reactor (fuel port or screen, its own slot): it breeds in the blanket for %s min at 100 %% and comes out irradiated. Up to %s wait in the slot.
jei.wmd.info.irradiated_breeder_rod: Holds %s mB tritium: the reprocessing plant extracts it (item hatch in, tritium port out on its east side) for the fusion reactor.
manual.wmd.fusion_fuel.title: 8b. Fusion fuel
manual.wmd.fusion_fuel.body: Lithium: Mg cell, 1 per %s brine cycles. 4 + W rod + Ti plate = breeder rod: %s min in a reactor = %s mB tritium.
gui.wmd.info.antimatter_collider: Burns %s mB/s hydrogen + %s mB/s water; one antimatter cell per %s min (an empty trap cell in, it holds 1)
gui.wmd.info.antimatter_store_hint: Take the cell out and carry it to a containment store
gui.wmd.info.antimatter_store: Holds %s antimatter cells; keep it powered: the backup lasts %s s
msg.wmd.antimatter_alarm: CONTAINMENT POWER LOST: %s antimatter cell(s), %s s of backup left
manual.wmd.antimatter.title: 8c. Antimatter
manual.wmd.antimatter.body: Collider: %s FE/s, %s mB/s H2 + %s mB/s water = 1 cell per %s min. Store: %s cells; keep it powered (backup %s s) or they are lost.
jei.wmd.info.antimatter_collider: The 33 x 33 antimatter ring (v0.8), hollow: walk in under its east gate. %s FE/s through one socket on the hall's east wall + hydrogen + cooling water (front ports): one antimatter cell from an empty trap cell every %s min. It holds one finished cell.
jei.wmd.info.antimatter_store: 5 x 4 x 5 vault for %s antimatter cells. While it holds any it draws %s FE/s; without power its backup lasts %s s, then the cells are lost. Mine it to take the cells with you.
jei.wmd.info.empty_trap_cell: A Penning-trap capsule. The antimatter collider fills it with antimatter.
jei.wmd.info.antimatter_cell: Trapped antimatter. The collider makes one every %s min; keep it in a powered containment store.
gui.wmd.info.repro_tritium: Irradiated breeder rod -> %s mB tritium in %s s (goes first; out of the east tritium port)
jei.wmd.info.superconducting_coil: The fusion reactor's magnets: platinum + titanium round a copper core. 4 go into a fusion reactor, 1 into the Fusion I research.
jei.wmd.info.tungsten_tile: Lines the inside of the fusion reactor's vacuum vessel (the plasma-facing wall).
gui.wmd.shell_press.start_tip: Start pressing the picked recipe (it keeps going until you stop it or the inputs run out)
gui.wmd.shell_press.stop_tip: Stop after the shell being pressed now
jei.wmd.info.leaflet: Printed leaflets: a leaflet shell with a message drops %s of them round its burst. Right-click one to read it.
message.wmd.big_drone.runway_flat: A T4 needs a flat runway: on the ground the hangar must stand on a floor (on a ship any deck works)
jei.wmd.note.heavy_water: Heavy-water upgrade in a water pump: per level 1 mB heavy water from every %s mB pumped (up to level 8)
jei.wmd.note.breeder: In the fission reactor's breeder slot while its rods are out (at 100 %%; slower at lower levels)
jei.wmd.note.tritium: An irradiated breeder rod goes first, before any plutonium run; out of the tritium port (east side)
jei.wmd.fluid.lookup: Press R on it for the machines that make it, U for what uses it. Over a machine's tank gauge works too.
jei.wmd.fluid.crude_oil: Pumped up by a PUMPJACK standing on a crude oil deposit (the oil detector finds them). Next: crude feed pump -> desalter.
jei.wmd.fluid.desalted_crude: Made by the DESALTER from crude oil (the salt water comes out as brine). Next: the furnace.
jei.wmd.fluid.hot_crude: Made by the FURNACE from desalted crude. Next: the crude distillation column.
jei.wmd.fluid.brine: The salt water the DESALTER takes out of crude oil. Feeds the brine electrolysis cell and the magnesium electrolyser.
jei.wmd.fluid.lpg: From the Crude Distillation Column (hot crude) and the FCC (LVGO / HVGO).
jei.wmd.fluid.naphtha: From the Crude Distillation Column (hot crude).
jei.wmd.fluid.kerosene: From the Crude Distillation Column (hot crude).
jei.wmd.fluid.diesel: From the Crude Distillation Column (hot crude).
jei.wmd.fluid.fuel_oil: From the Crude Distillation Column (the heavy bottom of hot crude). Next: the vacuum distillation column.
jei.wmd.fluid.lvgo: From the Vacuum Distillation Column (fuel oil). The FCC cracks it into gasoline + LPG.
jei.wmd.fluid.hvgo: From the Vacuum Distillation Column (fuel oil). The FCC cracks it into gasoline + LPG.
jei.wmd.fluid.coal_tar: From the COKE OVEN (2 coal -> 1 coke + coal tar). The starter generator burns it.
jei.wmd.fluid.bitumen: The bottom of the Vacuum Distillation Column (fuel oil).
jei.wmd.fluid.reformate: Made by the REFORMER from naphtha (hydrogen comes out too).
jei.wmd.fluid.gasoline: Made by the FCC from LVGO or HVGO.
jei.wmd.fluid.alkylate: Made by the ALKYLATION UNIT from LPG with an acid catalyst.
jei.wmd.fluid.jet_fuel: Made by the Jet Fuel Hydrotreater from kerosene + hydrogen.
jei.wmd.fluid.hydrogen: From the REFORMER (naphtha) and the Brine Electrolysis Cell (brine).
jei.wmd.fluid.chlorine: From the Brine Electrolysis Cell (brine) and the Magnesium Electrolyser (magnesium chloride).
jei.wmd.fluid.titanium_tetrachloride: Made by the Titanium Chlorinator from titanium concentrate + petroleum coke + chlorine.
jei.wmd.fluid.magnesium_chloride: Left over from the Titanium Reactor (titanium tetrachloride + magnesium); the magnesium electrolyser turns it back into magnesium.
jei.wmd.fluid.steam: Made by the fission (NUCLEAR) REACTOR from water. The steam turbine turns it into power.
jei.wmd.fluid.spent_steam: What leaves the STEAM TURBINE. The cooling tower turns it back into water.
jei.wmd.fluid.heavy_water: Made by a Water Pump with the heavy-water upgrade fitted (more levels = more). Feeds the automatic warhead lab and the deuterium cell.
jei.wmd.fluid.deuterium: Made by the Brine Electrolysis Cell from heavy water (pipe heavy water into its brine port; deuterium leaves by its hydrogen port). Fusion fuel.
jei.wmd.fluid.tritium: Made by the REPROCESSING PLANT from irradiated breeder rods (breeder rod = 4 lithium dust + tungsten rod + titanium plate, bred in a fission reactor). Fusion fuel.
gui.wmd.info.railgun: A %s min charge, then one slug anywhere in the dimension; it turns all the way round

message.wmd.station.camera_hover: The camera circles this module (ESC / sneak to come back)
manual.wmd.railgun.title: 8d. Railgun
manual.wmd.railgun.body: %s FE/s for a %s min charge; the dimension is warned. One slug, anywhere, any direction. An EMP or a hit within %s blocks dumps the charge.
jei.wmd.info.railgun: The railgun (v0.8): 15 x 10 x 15 turret. SET a target (X, Z) and FIRE: it turns onto it (any direction), loads a slug and draws %s FE/s for a %s min charge; the whole dimension sees the countdown. Then the slug hits anywhere in the world, stronger than antimatter, and everyone watches the cutscene. An EMP or a blast within %s blocks dumps the charge.
jei.wmd.info.railgun_slug: A tungsten penetrator wound with a superconducting coil. One per railgun shot.

manual.wmd.orbit_suit.body: Orbit is a vacuum: wear ALL FOUR suit pieces. The torso holds %s min of oxygen (its item bar, the EVA panel on screen).
manual.wmd.orbit_oxygen.title: Oxygen station
manual.wmd.orbit_oxygen.body: %s FE/s, water at the back, busbar east. Right-click it with a tank or the torso: full in %s s. Pour a tank into the worn torso by right-clicking.
manual.wmd.orbit_eva.title: Moving in orbit
manual.wmd.orbit_eva.body: Low gravity; the boots hold you to a hull. JUMP = up, SPRINT + W = fly, SNEAK = brake (3 x oxygen). More than %s blocks out = burn-up.
tooltip.wmd.crew_capsule: T4 launch terminal, upper slot. Up to %s crew board at the pad's TOWER LIFT (full EVA suit, right-click the podium at its foot) and ride it to your orbit slot
message.wmd.crew.aboard: You are aboard the crew capsule
message.wmd.crew.arrived: In orbit. Sneak to leave your seat (wear the full EVA suit!)
message.wmd.crew.off: The launch is off: you are back at the tower lift
message.wmd.crew.lift.no_capsule: No crew capsule is waiting on this pad
message.wmd.crew.lift.not_ready: The rocket is not ready yet (stacking or fuelling)
message.wmd.crew.lift.too_late: Too late: the countdown is running
message.wmd.crew.lift.busy: The lift is in use: wait until it is back down
message.wmd.crew.lift.suit: Wear the full EVA suit to board
message.wmd.crew.lift.use_lift: Crew capsule: board at the tower lift; the countdown starts when the crew is in
message.wmd.crew.lift.clock: Crew aboard: lift-off in %s s (more crew can still take the lift)
hud.wmd.crew.ride: Riding the crew capsule to orbit
death.attack.wmd.capsule_lost: %1$s went down with their crew capsule
death.attack.wmd.capsule_lost.player: %1$s went down with their crew capsule, shot down by %2$s
gui.wmd.capsule.title: Crew Capsule
gui.wmd.capsule.landed: Landed: recover it, then refurbish it
message.wmd.crew.recovered: Capsule recovered: refurbish it with 4 heat shield tiles
message.wmd.crew.border: That landing spot is outside the world border
manual.wmd.orbit_capsule.title: Crew capsule
manual.wmd.orbit_capsule.body: T4 upper slot. Up to %s crew: click the TOWER LIFT's foot (full suit). %s s after the first is in: countdown. In orbit: seat, or return %s east of the pad / to X Z.
message.wmd.station.breach: HULL BREACH: the %s is losing its air! Patch the hole (any full block) to seal it.
message.wmd.station.sealed: The %s is sealed again: the air comes back.
message.wmd.station.no_power: Station power empty: the air runs down. Add solar wings or wait for the sun.
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.core: Into a T4 launch terminal's upper slot. It flies up to your orbit slot and becomes your station's core node (the first module).
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.habitat: Into a T4 launch terminal's upper slot. It flies up and docks on a port of your station's core.
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.wing: Into a T4 launch terminal's upper slot. It flies up, docks on a port of your station's core and unfolds: power in the sun.
screen.wmd.terminal.hint.20: Your station already has a core
screen.wmd.terminal.hint.21: Your station has no core yet: launch the core kit first
screen.wmd.terminal.hint.22: This module's spot on your station is taken
message.wmd.station.arriving: The %s module has reached your orbit slot: it is coming in to dock.
message.wmd.station.lost_kit: The %s module could not dock (%s) and drifted away.
message.wmd.station.docked: The %s module has docked: latches closed.
message.wmd.station.blocked: The %s module is holding off the station: blocks are in its way.
gui.wmd.capsule.enter: Enter the station (down the top hatch)
manual.wmd.station.title: Space station
manual.wmd.station.body: Kits on a T4, core first. Core buffer %sM FE; each wing %s FE/t in the sun (%s of every %s min). Console: status + next port. Bunk: respawn.
gui.wmd.station.title: Space station
gui.wmd.station.next_port: Next AUTO module docks on port: %s
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.spot.wing: the core's north port (the second: south)
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.spot.core: your orbit slot (the core comes first)
gui.wmd.station.fixed: Fixed layout: every kit docks at its own spot
screen.wmd.terminal.hint.31: Dock the habitat first: this module docks on it
gui.wmd.station.not_owner: Only the owner picks the ports
message.wmd.station.bunk: Your respawn point is this bunk (while the habitat has air)
message.wmd.station.bunk_lost: Your bunk had no air (or is gone): you woke up on Earth.
message.wmd.station.rack_nothing: Hold an oxygen tank, or wear the suit torso
message.wmd.station.rack_no_power: The station has no power for the oxygen rack
tooltip.wmd.station_repair_kit: Right-click a station module: full health again and its missing hull blocks put back. Used up.
tooltip.wmd.engine_repair_kit: Right-click a damaged jet engine, turbofan or ducted fan on the ground: smoke and fire stop, a flamed-out engine runs again. Used up.
message.wmd.engine.repair_moving: Land first: engines can only be repaired at rest
message.wmd.station.repaired: The %s is repaired (%s hull blocks put back)
message.wmd.station.wrecked: The %s is WRECKED: no air, no power. A station repair kit brings it back.
subtitles.wmd.st_air_rush: Air rushes out of the hull

message.wmd.cargo.no_port: Your cargo pod reached orbit but no core port was free: it burnt up (%s stacks)
message.wmd.cargo.arriving: Your cargo pod is docking on port %s (%s stacks aboard)
message.wmd.cargo.docking: Still docking: wait for the clamps
message.wmd.cargo.not_owner: Only the pod's owner can release it
message.wmd.cargo.released: Cargo pod released: it de-orbits and burns up
message.wmd.cargo.released_burnt: Cargo pod released with %s stacks still aboard: they burn up with it

screen.wmd.terminal.cargo_away: Cargo pod launched: climbing to your station

message.wmd.reboost.border: That point is outside the world border

message.wmd.reboost.done: Re-boost done: the station now hangs over %s, %s
message.wmd.reboost.not_owner: Only the station's owner can re-boost
manual.wmd.cargo.title: Cargo pod + re-boost
manual.wmd.cargo.body: %s slots on a T4: docks on a free core port. Unload it there or from the console; Release (2 presses). Re-boost: a cell per %s blocks, %s s per 1,000, max %s.
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.sensor: A boom + a 9-wide radar dish on a core port: sees other stations, threats and the ground below
message.wmd.sensor.incoming: SENSOR ARRAY: %s from %s climbing to your station, %s s out!

manual.wmd.sensor.title: Sensor array
manual.wmd.sensor.body: Station kit on a free core port, %s FE/t. Sees every other station and threats climbing to yours (alarm + countdown), and launches in the %s-block picture below. Station screen: Sensor tab.
tooltip.wmd.station_kit.laser: A 7 x 7 x 11 gun deck with a nose turret and a 21-block emitter on a core port. One per station.

manual.wmd.station_laser.title: Station laser
manual.wmd.station_laser.body: Kit on a core port. Charge: %sM FE, %s s, then it holds ARMED. Laser tab: fire at satellites overhead or stations (%s dmg); AUTO burns ASATs + boost-phase missiles below. ASAT tab pick: %s dmg.
screen.wmd.terminal.hint.27: Boarding: the target station has no free port (fill your ports = a defence)
gui.wmd.station.by_eye: Blind: close stations seen by eye

message.wmd.laser.close_only: A close-mode charge only reaches stations in close range
gui.wmd.station.lz_idle_close: CLOSE MODE: a shot costs %sk FE

message.wmd.mirv.split: MIRV split: %s warheads on their way (spread %s)

message.wmd.winter.end: The nuclear winter is over: the sky clears, the snow melts.

tooltip.wmd.station_kit.port_far: Port: beyond the habitat on port %s (%s)

manual.wmd.winter.title: Nuclear winter
manual.wmd.winter.body: Nuke 1, thermonuclear 2, Tsar 5: %s within %s days and ash covers the sky for %s days: snow everywhere, crops at half speed.
manual.wmd.mirror.title: Solar mirror
manual.wmd.mirror.body: Core port or past a habitat. DEPLOY at the desk, click the map to steer, FOCUS twice: in the station's sun, by day, clear sky; %s min a burn, %s FE/t; %s blocks warned.

manual.wmd.forcefield.title: Forcefield
manual.wmd.forcefield.body: A hex dome, radius %s to %s, over your base. Warheads inside are absorbed; the railgun and antimatter shatter it. Only you + your whitelist pass. Boots at %s%%. Shattered: down 20 min.
jei.wmd.info.forcefield_generator: Throws a dome of hex panels, radius %s to %s (set in its screen), over your base. Every warhead that lands inside is absorbed and drains its buffer (%s FE, charged at up to %s FE/t through the busbar sockets east and west). The railgun, antimatter, a hit bigger than the buffer or an EMP crack it and it shatters like glass. Only the owner and the whitelist walk through it.
jei.wmd.info.wh.nanite: No blast: a swarm of nanites grows to a sphere of 24 blocks over 2 minutes and eats every block inside it. An EMP kills it at once.
jei.wmd.info.wh.gravity: A gravity well over the target pulls players, mobs and loose blocks within 30 blocks into one point for 30 seconds, then violently throws everything out.
jei.wmd.info.wh.cryo: A freeze wave out to 40 blocks: water turns to ice, snow falls, machines and living things freeze for 1 minute. Heat thaws you (and a machine) sooner.
manual.wmd.exotic.title: Exotic warheads

gui.wmd.torpedo_line.stage.fit: Fitting battery, motor, warhead and seeker

gui.wmd.fcc.no_targets: No targets: sonar on this frequency finds them
gui.wmd.fcc.pick_target: %s target(s): click one on the map or use < >
