manual.wmd.fire_control_console.title: Fire control console
manual.wmd.fire_control_console.body: Lists tubes, deck launchers, cells + coastal batteries on its frequency. Click a target, AIM ALL, FIRE or SALVO (%s degrees apart). Gyro %s degrees after %s blocks. STRIKE: next page. %s FE/s.
item.wmd.noisemaker.desc: Acoustic decoy: use it aboard a sub (ejected under the hull) or in the water. Louder than any ship for %1$s s: pulls homing torpedoes off. One at a time (%1$s s cooldown)
message.wmd.noisemaker.out: Noisemaker out: it sounds for %s s
message.wmd.noisemaker.no_water: Use it aboard a ship in the water, or under water
message.wmd.torpedo.wire_cut: %s: the wire is out, it is homing on its own now
tooltip.wmd.torpedo.guide.torpedo_t2: Homes: listens %s blocks ahead for the loudest ship, pings when it hears none (a noisemaker fools it)
tooltip.wmd.torpedo.guide.torpedo_t3: Wire-guided for %2$s blocks to the fire control console's target, then homes (listens %1$s blocks)
item.wmd.depth_charge.desc: Load it into a depth charge rack, or throw it over the side (goes off %s blocks deep, or on a hull / the seabed)
gui.wmd.info.depth_charge_rack: Stern rack: holds 3 depth charges and rolls them off over the end, one at a time or all in a pattern
gui.wmd.dc.loaded: %s of 3 depth charges on the rails
gui.wmd.dc.depth: Fuse: goes off %s blocks below the surface
gui.wmd.dc.hint_redstone: A redstone pulse drops one too
gui.wmd.dc.hint_place: Place it looking out over the stern
gui.wmd.dc.hint_power: Power the release on the busbar socket
message.wmd.depth_charge.depth: Depth charge went off at %s %s %s (%s deep), %s hull blast(s)
message.wmd.depth_charge.ship: Depth charge hit a hull at %s %s %s (%s deep), %s hull blast(s)
message.wmd.depth_charge.bottom: Depth charge hit the seabed at %s %s %s (%s deep), %s hull blast(s)
manual.wmd.depth_charge.title: Depth charges
manual.wmd.depth_charge.body: Sinks %s blocks/s, goes off at the rack's depth (%s to %s) or on a hull / the seabed. The stern rack holds 3: DROP ONE or PATTERN. Place it looking out over the stern. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.noisemaker.title: Noisemaker
manual.wmd.noisemaker.body: An acoustic decoy. Use it aboard a sub (it is ejected under the hull) or in the water. For %s s it is louder than any ship: a homing torpedo that hears it turns for it.
gui.wmd.info.noisemaker_launcher: A sealed hull block: ejects one of its %s noisemakers out of the muzzle (a decoy for %s s). AUTO fires when a stranger's torpedo comes within %s blocks of the ship
gui.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.hint_place: Fires the way you looked when you placed it
gui.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.hint_auto: AUTO: a stranger's torpedo within %s blocks
message.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.st.2: Noisemaker launcher: the ejector is still charging
message.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.st.4: Noisemaker launcher: something blocks the muzzle
message.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.st.5: Noisemaker launcher: the muzzle is not in water
manual.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.title: Noisemaker Launcher
manual.wmd.noisemaker_launcher.body: A sealed hull block. Build it in from inside, facing the sea. Holds %s noisemakers. FIRE, redstone, or AUTO: a stranger's torpedo within %s blocks of your ship (one decoy at a time). %s FE a shot, busbar inside.
item.wmd.sonobuoy.desc: Throw it on the sea: it floats, drops a hydrophone and listens for %s min out to %s blocks on its sonar frequency
item.wmd.sonobuoy.freq: Sonar frequency %s (use it on one of your sonar consoles to change it)
message.wmd.sonobuoy.out: Sonobuoy out on frequency %s: it listens for %s min
manual.wmd.sonobuoy.title: Sonobuoy
manual.wmd.sonobuoy.body: Use it on your sonar console to copy its frequency, then throw it on the sea. It listens %s min out to %s blocks, ear %s deep. Two buoys cross-fix a sub.
item.wmd.asroc.desc: Fired from a launch cell at the fire control target (%s to %s blocks): it flies there and drops a homing torpedo
gui.wmd.info.launch_cell: Holds one round (anti-sub rocket, SLBM or cruise missile + capsules); fires surfaced or not too deep
gui.wmd.lc.no_target: No target: pick one on the console
gui.wmd.lc.st.4: The target is out of range
gui.wmd.lc.st.5: The hatch is too deep: come up
message.wmd.asroc.separated: Anti-sub rocket: booster burnt out, the torpedo is coming down under its parachute near %s %s
message.wmd.asroc.splash: Anti-sub rocket: the torpedo is in the water at %s %s %s and hunting
message.wmd.asroc.lost: Anti-sub rocket came down on land at %s %s %s: the torpedo is lost
tooltip.wmd.slbm.use: Load it into a launch cell: it rises out of the sea, lights and flies as a ballistic missile
tooltip.wmd.cruise_capsule.desc: A launch cell uses one per cruise missile: it floats the missile up to the surface (and carries its alkylate)
gui.wmd.bay.mode_airframe.5: An SLBM takes a T3 airframe, a plain T3 motor and a ground-attack warhead
gui.wmd.lc.need_xz: Type both X and Z first
message.wmd.slbm.away: SLBM away to %s %s (%s blocks): it is now a ballistic missile in flight
message.wmd.lc.cruise_away: Cruise missile away from the cell to %s %s: %s blocks, about %s s
manual.wmd.slbm.title: SLBM
manual.wmd.slbm.body: Bay mode SLBM: T3 airframe, plain T3 motor, any ground warhead. Range %s (at least %s). Target: the cell's own, else the console's STRIKE page. LAUNCH: it rises, lights %s up.
manual.wmd.cell_cruise.title: Cruise missile in a cell
manual.wmd.cell_cruise.body: A cruise missile fits a launch cell too, with one cruise capsule per launch (%s in the cell). It floats up, the capsule drops away, the missile flies to the strike target.
manual.wmd.launch_cell.title: Launch cell
manual.wmd.launch_cell.body: 2 x 7 x 2, through the hull. One round: anti-sub rocket, SLBM or cruise missile. Rocket range %s to %s blocks. Max %s deep, %s FE/s. Lamps: blue empty, green loaded, amber armed, red fired.
item.wmd.torpedo_t4.desc: Rocket-driven in its own gas bubble: very fast, long range, very loud; sprints to the fire control point, then pings and locks
item.wmd.uuv.desc: Fired from a torpedo tube: runs its course quietly and listens for your sonar on the tube's frequency
tooltip.wmd.torpedo.guide.torpedo_t4: Sprint and search: deaf at full speed, it slows near its fire control point, pings once and locks the nearest ship (a noisemaker does not fool it)
tooltip.wmd.uuv.stats: %s blocks/s, runs %s blocks then holds station; listens %s min out to %s blocks
message.wmd.uuv.station: UUV on station at %s %s %s (%s blocks out): listening
message.wmd.uuv.gone: UUV battery flat at %s %s %s: it scuttled
manual.wmd.torpedo_t4.title: Supercavitating torpedo
manual.wmd.torpedo_t4.body: Rocket torpedo in its own gas bubble: %s blocks/s for %s blocks. It sprints to the fire control point, slows, pings once and locks the nearest ship. Everyone hears it.
manual.wmd.uuv.title: Underwater drone (UUV)
manual.wmd.uuv.body: Fire it from a torpedo tube (gyro and depth work). It runs %s blocks quietly, then holds station, listening out to %s blocks for %s min on the tube's frequency: set your sonar console to it.
manual.wmd.torpedo_line.title: Torpedo line
manual.wmd.torpedo_line.body: Place the section shop, then build the fit-out bay and test stand from its Line tab. Materials in on the shop's west side, power on its east side. A T1 takes %s s at %s FE/s; the test stand's rack holds %s.
gui.wmd.sonar.none_sensors: No dome or array on this frequency
gui.wmd.sonar.map_help1: Seen from above, north up, this console in the middle
gui.wmd.sonar.map_help2: Dashed line: a sound one sensor hears (direction only)
gui.wmd.sonar.map_help3: Number: two sensors cross on it. Letter: a ping found it (wrecks: SEABED)
gui.wmd.sonar.hist_help1: Across: the direction a sound comes from (N E S W)
gui.wmd.sonar.hist_help2: Top = now, lower = older; a moving ship leaves a slanting trail
gui.wmd.sonar.tip_nofix: Only one sensor hears it: add a 2nd dome or array further away for a position
manual.wmd.sonar.title: Sonar: how it works
manual.wmd.sonar.body: Radar cannot see a submerged ship; sonar can. Fast = loud, under %s blocks/s = quiet, stopped = silent. Sonar gives a BEARING; two on one frequency make a FIX. A layer %s deep hides %s dB.
manual.wmd.sonar_dome.title: Sonar dome
manual.wmd.sonar_dome.body: Goes through a hull, window under water. Hears %s blocks. PING: every ship within %s shown exactly for %s s, but the %s dB ping gives you away. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.hydrophone_array.title: Hydrophone array
manual.wmd.hydrophone_array.body: A fixed passive listening station for the seabed or under a pier. Hears out to %s blocks, never gives itself away. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.sonar_console.title: Sonar console
manual.wmd.sonar_console.body: MAP: dashed line = a sound heard, number = two sensors cross, letter = a ping result. HISTORY = old bearings. SEABED = the nodule survey. HUNTING pings whenever a dome can (loud). %s FE/s.
tooltip.wmd.nodule_field: Metal lumps on the deep seabed. Not minable: a dredge winch or a seabed crawler picks them up
tooltip.wmd.manganese_nodule: From the deep seabed. Smelts into manganese, or a collector rig separates it into concentrates
tooltip.wmd.manganese_concentrate: Washed by a collector rig: smelts into 2 manganese ingots
tooltip.wmd.nickel_cobalt_concentrate: The heavy part of the nodules (collector rig only): smelts into nickel-cobalt alloy
tooltip.wmd.manganese_ingot: Tough steel for the seabed crawler's tracks
tooltip.wmd.nickel_cobalt_ingot: Heat-proof superalloy: the T4 supercavitating torpedo needs it
tooltip.wmd.seabed_crawler: Put it in a collector rig and LAUNCH: it drives over the seabed collecting nodules
gui.wmd.info.dredge_winch: Lowers a grab bucket to the seabed in front and brings up manganese nodules
gui.wmd.info.collector_rig: Sends a crawler over the seabed and separates the nodules it pumps up
gui.wmd.dredge.st.2: No water in front of it
gui.wmd.dredge.st.4: Output full: take the nodules out
gui.wmd.dredge.st.5: Came up empty: no nodules in reach
gui.wmd.dredge.st.6: The ship drifted off the grab
gui.wmd.dredge.hint_place: Place it looking out over the water
gui.wmd.rig.st.3: No water past the north edge
gui.wmd.rig.st.5: Field worked out: move the rig
gui.wmd.rig.hint_place: North edge on the deck edge
manual.wmd.dredge_winch.title: Nodules + dredge
manual.wmd.dredge_winch.body: Nodule fields lie on deep ocean floors (%s+ water). Place the winch looking out over the water: its bucket lands on a field within %s of the drop and brings up %s-%s nodules. Cable %s. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.collector_rig.title: Collector rig
manual.wmd.collector_rig.body: North edge on the deck edge, load a crawler, LAUNCH: it collects within %s of the riser. %s nodules make %s Mn + %s Ni-Co concentrate. %s FE/s.
gui.wmd.info.depth_charge_thrower: K-gun: throws the depth charge on its arbor out over the side, the davit swings the spare in; a depth charge rack next to it keeps it fed. It also lays sea mines: load one by hand
gui.wmd.kgun.freq: Fire control %s: SALVO throws it too
gui.wmd.kgun.no_freq: No fire control frequency (tab on the left)
gui.wmd.kgun.hint_place: Throws the way you looked when you placed it
gui.wmd.kgun.hint_rack: A rack touching it feeds drums; mines go in by hand
gui.wmd.kgun.hint_redstone: A redstone pulse on any block throws
gui.wmd.kgun.spare_mine: a spare mine on the rack
gui.wmd.kgun.mine_bottom: Bottom mine: lies on the seabed where it lands
gui.wmd.kgun.freq_mine: Fire control %s: SALVO skips a mine (THROW lays it)
message.wmd.kgun.mine_armed: %s loaded into the mine on the K-gun
message.wmd.kgun.mine_in: %s on the K-gun: THROW lays it %s blocks deep
message.wmd.kgun.mine_in_loaded: %s on the K-gun, loaded with a %s from your inventory
message.wmd.kgun.mine_in_empty: %s on the K-gun, EMPTY: no %s on you (right-click one on the K-gun to load it)
gui.wmd.seamine.title: Sea mine
gui.wmd.seamine.what_influence: Blows when a hull comes within %1$s of the case (hits hulls out to %2$s)
gui.wmd.seamine.what_bottom: Lies on the seabed; a hull up to %3$s above it: its rocket rises at it
gui.wmd.seamine.what_captor: A sub within %4$s of the canister: its T2 torpedo goes for it
gui.wmd.seamine.depth: Case depth: %s blocks under the surface
gui.wmd.seamine.floats: Floats %s deep now, %s blocks of cable out
gui.wmd.seamine.hint_arm: Arms %s s after it is laid or loaded
gui.wmd.seamine.hint_friends: Never goes off for your own or trusted ships
gui.wmd.seamine.hint_take: Sneak + empty hand: take it back
message.wmd.seamine.water: Sea mines are laid in open water (not on land, not on a ship)
message.wmd.seamine.loaded: Mine loaded: it arms in a moment
message.wmd.seamine.rise: Your bottom mine at %s %s %s fired its rocket
message.wmd.seamine.captor: Your captor mine at %s %s %s released its torpedo
message.wmd.seamine.blast: Sea mine went off at %s %s %s (%s deep), %s hull blast(s)
item.wmd.sea_mine.depth: Laying depth: case %s blocks under the surface
item.wmd.sea_mine.lay: Use at a ship's rail, a pier or a boat: over the side, it sinks and moors itself on the seabed
item.wmd.sea_mine.lay_depth: Sneak + use: change the laying depth
item.wmd.sea_mine.lay_load: Laid over the side it takes a %s from your off hand / inventory, so it lands loaded
message.wmd.seamine.lay_depth: Laying depth: %s blocks under the surface
message.wmd.seamine.lay_nodepth: A bottom mine lies on the seabed (no depth to set)
message.wmd.seamine.lay_rail: Stand at the rail and lay it over the side (your deck or hull is under it)
message.wmd.seamine.lay_nowater: No sea below: lay sea mines over open water
message.wmd.seamine.lay_shallow: Too shallow here: %s blocks of water, a mine needs %s

message.wmd.seamine.lay_over_empty: Mine over the side EMPTY (no %s on you)

message.wmd.seamine.lay_why_offline: you were not online when it landed
message.wmd.seamine.lay_why_land: it landed out of the water or on a ship
message.wmd.seamine.lay_why_shallow: the water there is too shallow
message.wmd.seamine.lay_why_room: no room on the seabed there
gui.wmd.fcc.s_no_target: No strike target: type X Z
gui.wmd.fcc.s_hint1: Cells with no own target fly here
gui.wmd.fcc.s_pick: Click a row to select it
gui.wmd.fcc.s_how: Put cells / batteries on this freq
gui.wmd.fcc.own_set: Row %s now has its own target %s %s
gui.wmd.fcc.strike_none: Strike target %s %s set: no loaded SLBM / cruise cell uses it
gui.wmd.fcc.strike_result: Strike target %s %s: %s in range, %s too far, %s too close
manual.wmd.launch_aboard.title: Launch control aboard
manual.wmd.launch_aboard.body: Console STRIKE page: type X Z, SET = the target of every SLBM / cruise cell with none of its own (with a range check). GIVE TO SELECTED = one row's own. STRIKE SALVO: cells + batteries. %s rows.
manual.wmd.kgun.title: K-gun
manual.wmd.kgun.body: Throws a depth charge ~16 out the way you faced when placing it (THROW, redstone, SALVO). Reload %s s, fed by a rack. A sea mine loaded by hand moors at the dial depth. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.sea_mines.title: Sea mines
manual.wmd.sea_mines.body: Laid in open water, no power. Never set off by you or trusted players; armed %s s after laying. A sonar ping shows them; a blast close by sets them off. Sneak + empty hand takes one back.
jei.wmd.note.dredge: Grabs %s-%s nodules from a nodule field within %s blocks of the drop; cable %s
jei.wmd.note.crawler: The crawler picks up %s-%s nodules a block within %s of the riser
jei.wmd.note.separator: The hydrocyclone washes off the silt and splits the heavy fraction
gui.wmd.sonar.node_mode: Passive, wireless, on its own battery
gui.wmd.info.coastal_battery: %s alkylate canister per missile; skims %s blocks over the sea
gui.wmd.info.dock_crane: Hook reach %s-%s blocks from its centre, %s down
gui.wmd.coastal.no_pick: Pick a target on a fire console
gui.wmd.coastal.no_typed: Type X and Z, then Set target
gui.wmd.coastal.need_target: Type the target X and Z first
message.wmd.coastal.away: Anti-ship missile %s away: target %s %s, %s blocks, ~%s s
gui.wmd.crane.hint2: Loads tubes, cells, a sub's rack
manual.wmd.towed_array_winch.title: Towed array winch
manual.wmd.towed_array_winch.body: A sub's long ear: hears %s blocks. Stern, fairlead aft: streams %s blocks of cable. Deaf over %s b/s, after turns over %s deg/s (%s s). %s FE/s. REEL IN or redstone winds it in.
manual.wmd.listening_node.title: Listening node
manual.wmd.listening_node.body: Wireless seabed post: hears %s blocks, reports on its frequency. ~%s h on its battery; the turbine adds %s FE/t in still water, %s in a current. Flat = asleep until 25 %%. %s FE/t.
manual.wmd.coastal_battery.title: Coastal battery
manual.wmd.coastal_battery.body: Shore anti-ship launcher: 4 cruise missiles + alkylate. Aims at the fire control pick or a typed X Z; locks a ship within %s blocks. Skims %s blocks over the sea. The console lists + fires it. %s FE/s.
manual.wmd.dock_crane.title: Dock crane
manual.wmd.dock_crane.body: Loads a sub at the pen. Hook reach %s-%s blocks out, %s down. Lifts torpedoes / missiles from a pier chest or rack into tubes, cells, a coastal battery or the sub's rack. %s FE/s.
jei.wmd.info.mine_influence: Influence sea mine: lay it in open water (the anchor sits where you place it, the case floats on its cable at the depth set on its screen). Any hull that is not yours or trusted coming within %s blocks of the case sets it off; the blast reaches hulls %s blocks away. Arms %s s after laying. Or use it at a ship's rail, a pier or a boat: it goes over the side, sinks and moors itself (sneak + use sets the laying depth).
jei.wmd.info.mine_bottom: Rising bottom mine: lies on the seabed. Load it with a Torpedo T1 (right-click). A hull passing within %s blocks sideways and %s above makes the cap flip and the rocket rise at it. Load another T1 to re-arm. Or use it at a ship's rail, a pier or a boat: it goes over the side and sinks to the seabed, taking a T1 from your inventory so it lands loaded.
jei.wmd.info.mine_captor: Captor mine: a moored canister. Load it with a Torpedo T2 (right-click). A submerged sub within %s blocks gets the homing torpedo. Load another T2 to re-arm. Or use it at a ship's rail, a pier or a boat: it goes over the side, sinks and moors itself (sneak + use sets the laying depth). Laid over the side it takes a T2 from your inventory, so it lands loaded.
jei.wmd.info.depth_charge_thrower: K-gun: throws a depth charge about 16 blocks to the side (the way you looked when you placed it). The davit reloads the spare in %s s; a depth charge rack touching it keeps it fed. Needs power on the busbar socket. Load a sea mine by hand and THROW lays it the same way: it moors where it lands, at the depth dial (3..90).
jei.wmd.info.engine_telegraph: Ship bridge control, no power needed. Click the dial for a throttle step (FLANK to ASTERN) and the wheel for the rudder; every WMD engine on the same physics ship follows it.
jei.wmd.info.helm_station: A seat that steers the ship: W/S throttle, A/D rudder, Space/Shift rise and dive (Deep Seas ballast too). Right-click to stand up. Drives every WMD engine on the same ship.
jei.wmd.info.jato_booster: Load it into a JATO rack: %s seconds of heavy thrust (the step past FLANK, or a redstone signal), then the empty bottle drops away.
jei.wmd.info.jet_power_core: Feeds every WMD block on the same physics ship (engines, radar, pods) without busbars. Holds %s FE; charges from a busbar while parked or runs its jet fuel APU.
jei.wmd.info.aam_heat: Short-range heat-seeking air-to-air missile (%s blocks). Locks only from behind the target: within 60 degrees of its exhaust (80 on afterburner or a burning JATO); hotter engines are seen farther. No warning for the target; flares fool it. Load on a pylon, launch rail or weapons bay.
jei.wmd.info.aam_radar: Medium-range radar air-to-air missile (%s blocks). Your radar must hold the lock until it is %s blocks from the target, then it guides itself. Chaff fools it. Also the SAM site's round.
jei.wmd.info.aam_arm: Anti-radiation missile (%s blocks): homes on a radar or jammer that is switched on. If the radar goes quiet it flies to the last known spot.
jei.wmd.info.aam_agm: Air-to-ground missile (%s blocks): flies to one of your laser spots in front of the launcher (targeting pod, laser tripod, laser tablet, designator satellite). Smoke or a lost spot: it flies on to the last spot.
jei.wmd.info.wing_section: A lift block for your aircraft: panel, leading and trailing edges, swept edges and wingtips (wrench to change). Lift grows with airspeed, like a sail.
jei.wmd.info.control_surface: A moving flap for your aircraft (aileron, elevator, rudder and more; wrench to change the role). It follows the cockpit, the helm or a redstone signal.
manual.wmd.mine_influence.title: Influence mine
manual.wmd.mine_influence.body: The anchor sits where you place it, the case floats on its cable at the depth set on its screen. A hull within %s blocks of the case blows it; it holes hulls out to %s.
manual.wmd.mine_bottom.title: Rising bottom mine
manual.wmd.mine_bottom.body: Lies on the seabed. Load a T1 torpedo (right-click). A hull within %s sideways and %s above: the cap flips and its rocket rises at it.
manual.wmd.mine_captor.title: Captor mine
manual.wmd.mine_captor.body: A moored canister. Load a T2 torpedo (right-click). A submerged sub within %s blocks gets the homing torpedo; reload to re-arm.
command.wmd.retrogen.nodules: Nodule retrogen: %s chunk(s) queued, %s already done, %s not loaded here (they are done when they load)
command.wmd.retrogen.nodules_off: Nodule retrogen is switched OFF (config noduleRetrogen / ore switch nodules): %s chunk(s) would be queued, %s done, %s not loaded
message.wmd.naval_reactor.repaired: Naval reactor repaired. It stays shut down until you pick a level.
gui.wmd.periscope.blocked: Mast blocked: the top must face open water or air

gui.wmd.escape_pod.hatch_blocked: Hatch blocked: the top must face open water or air
message.wmd.comms_buoy.blocked: Buoy hatch blocked: the top must face open water or air
