message.wmd.naval_reactor.scram: NAVAL REACTOR AUTO-SCRAM at %s %s %s: overheating! Restore the cooling water or it melts down.
message.wmd.naval_reactor.damaged: The naval reactor at %s %s %s overheated and is DAMAGED: use a reactor repair kit on it.
message.wmd.comms_buoy.too_fast: Too fast for the comms buoy: reeling it in
message.wmd.escape_pod.auto: The hull is going: ESCAPE POD AWAY!
message.wmd.escape_pod.ejected: Escape pod away! Sneak to climb out once it floats.
message.wmd.att.lost: Your %s was destroyed by an anti-torpedo torpedo
message.wmd.att.kill: Anti-torpedo torpedo hit: %s incoming torpedo(es) destroyed
message.wmd.att.end: Anti-torpedo torpedo found nothing and self-destructed
message.wmd.att.ground: Anti-torpedo torpedo hit the seabed or a wall
gui.wmd.info.naval_reactor: Fuel rods last %s h at 100%%; up to %s%% the pumps are off (silent)
gui.wmd.info.naval_reactor_cool: Sits in a glass coolant tank that only PUMPED water fills (WATER IN on the west): a running core boils it off, so keep a pump feeding it. A blast can crack the tank: seal it with a reactor repair kit
gui.wmd.info.periscope: Raised it shows on radar as a tiny blip and leaves a wake
gui.wmd.info.comms_buoy: Deeper than %s blocks a sub only reaches its own hull; a floating buoy links it again
gui.wmd.info.escape_pod: Takes up to %s players near it to the surface; goes by itself if the sub implodes or floods
manual.wmd.naval_reactor.title: Naval reactor
manual.wmd.naval_reactor.body: Sub power plant: %s FE/s at 100 %%, fuel rods %s h each. Its glass coolant tank needs water pumped in all the time. A blast cracks it: seal it with a repair kit. QUIET to %s %%: silent. SCRAM at %s heat, then meltdown.
manual.wmd.periscope.title: Periscope
manual.wmd.periscope.body: 1 x 3 mast through the top hull. RAISE it, then right-click to look: wheel = x%s / x%s. The head stands %s blocks over the hull: works only at periscope depth. Up = a tiny radar blip and a wake.
manual.wmd.comms_buoy.title: Comms buoy
manual.wmd.comms_buoy.body: Radio stops under water: deeper than %s blocks a sub reaches only its own tubes and domes. RELEASE the buoy (%s block cable) to link again. Radar and sonar can spot it.
manual.wmd.torpedo_att.title: Anti-torpedo torpedo
manual.wmd.torpedo_att.body: Load it in a tube or deck launcher on a net with sonar. It fires BY ITSELF at an enemy torpedo coming within %s blocks, runs %s b/s and blows the torpedo up (no warhead blast). Built on the torpedo line.
manual.wmd.escape_pod.title: Escape pod
manual.wmd.escape_pod.body: Up to %s players within %s blocks ride it to the surface: EJECT, or by itself when the sub implodes or floods. Sneak to climb out. Re-arm the cradle with an escape capsule (hit an empty pod to get one back).
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_weak_none: Reads the submarine this console is aboard
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_nosub2: Put the console inside a Deep Seas sub
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_nods2: the HULL page reads its submarines
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_help1: Depth bar: how deep you are against the crush depth of your weakest outer hull block.
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_help2: Red tick = %s%%: past it the chip turns red. Flooding: water inside each third of the hull.
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_help3: BOW is the way you look when you face this console.
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_st_breached: BREACHED: water is coming in (%s cracks)
gui.wmd.sonar.hull_st_holed: HULL OPEN: the inside reaches the sea (%s cracks)
gui.wmd.sonar.none_domes: No sonar dome on this frequency
gui.wmd.sonar.none_survey1: No nodule fields surveyed here yet
gui.wmd.sonar.sea_help1: Sand discs = surveyed manganese nodule fields, real size
gui.wmd.sonar.sea_help2: Dashed ring = what each dome surveys (%s blocks)
gui.wmd.sonar.sea_help3: Marks stay about an hour; a new survey updates them
gui.wmd.sonar.sea_help4: Grey letters: wrecks a ping found
gui.wmd.sonar.surveying: %s dome(s) surveying the seabed within %s blocks
gui.wmd.sonar.survey_none: No dome could survey (cooldown, no power or dry)
gui.wmd.sonar.survey_why.power: Dome needs %2$s FE for a survey, it has %1$s
gui.wmd.sonar.survey_why.dry: The dome window is not under water
gui.wmd.sonar.survey_why.link: %s dome(s) out of reach: deep on another boat, no comms link
gui.wmd.sonar.survey_done: Seabed survey: %s nodule field(s) within %s blocks
manual.wmd.nodule_survey.title: Nodule survey
manual.wmd.sub_hull.title: Hull page
manual.wmd.sub_hull.body: Console HULL tab, aboard a Deep Seas sub: depth vs the crush depth of your weakest hull block (red past %s %%), breaches, cracks, water per BOW / MID / STERN, leaks. Every %s s.
manual.wmd.nodule_survey.body: Console SEABED tab, SURVEY SEABED: each dome maps the nodule fields within %s blocks (a ping's cost, loud). Marks last %s min; the dredge and rig screens show the nearest.
tooltip.wmd.screw_propeller: 1 x 1 x 2 stern tube: fits the narrow end of a sub. The screw turns behind it, under water. Follows the telegraph / helm; redstone sets its throttle
tooltip.wmd.screw_propeller.skin: Right-click it with a block: the tube takes that look (uses the block; sneak + wrench gives it back). Wrench: + tail, X tail, no tail. Busbar on top, Create drive in front
tooltip.wmd.engine_telegraph: Click the dial: right half ahead, left half astern. Click the wheel: rudder. No power
tooltip.wmd.helm_station: Sit to steer: W/S throttle, A/D rudder, Space/Shift dive planes. Needs power
tooltip.wmd.needs_sable: Needs Sable (physics ships) to move a ship
gui.wmd.info.screw_use: Uses %s FE/s turning, up to %s FE/s at FLANK
gui.wmd.screw.no_sable: Sable is not installed: it turns but pushes nothing
gui.wmd.screw.dry: Screw out of the water: no thrust
message.wmd.telegraph.no_ship: Telegraph: %s (not aboard a ship: nothing answers)
message.wmd.telegraph.status: Telegraph: order %s, engines answer %s, rudder order %s deg (real %s deg)
message.wmd.helm.taken: Someone is already at the helm
message.wmd.helm.seated: At the helm: W/S throttle, A/D rudder, Space/Shift planes, right-click to stand up
hud.wmd.helm.title: HELM
hud.wmd.helm.hint: W/S throttle   A/D rudder   Space/Shift rise/dive   Right-click: stand up
manual.wmd.screw_propeller.title: Screw propeller
manual.wmd.screw_propeller.body: Sable ship drive: stern, screw aft, under water. Obeys the telegraph / helm; redstone = throttle. %s FE/s, %s at FLANK (busbar or Create). A block skins its hull (sneak + wrench gives it back).
manual.wmd.engine_telegraph.title: Engine telegraph
manual.wmd.engine_telegraph.body: No power. Dial: right half = ahead, left = astern. Wheel: %s deg of rudder a click, sneak = amidships. The bell rings when the engines answer.
manual.wmd.helm_station.title: Helm station
manual.wmd.helm_station.body: Sit: W/S throttle, A/D rudder, Space/Shift rise/dive, right-click to stand. HUD: depth, crush, heading, speed, orders, noise. %s FE/s manned.
message.wmd.screw.x_tail: Tail: X (the fins mix rudder and planes)
message.wmd.screw.plus_tail: Tail: + (rudder up and down, planes left and right)
tooltip.wmd.pump_jet: 3 x 3 x 3 quiet ship drive: duct faces aft, under water. Follows the telegraph / helm; redstone sets its throttle
tooltip.wmd.copycat_hull: Right-click its hull with a block: the hull takes that look (uses the block; sneak + wrench gives it back)
tooltip.wmd.sub_diesel: 2 x 2 x 3 diesel-electric set: diesel in, FE out to the batteries
tooltip.wmd.sub_diesel.air: Needs air: surfaced it just runs, submerged it needs a raised snorkel mast on the same ship
tooltip.wmd.snorkel_mast: 1 x 3 mast through the top hull: raised, the sub diesels breathe at snorkel depth
gui.wmd.info.snorkel_mast: Raised it lets the sub diesels breathe, shows a tiny radar blip and leaves a feather wake
gui.wmd.info.sub_diesel: Makes %s FE from each mB of diesel
manual.wmd.pump_jet.title: Pump-jet propulsor
manual.wmd.pump_jet.body: Quiet Sable ship drive: stern, duct aft, under water. Telegraph / helm; redstone = throttle. X tail + vectoring nozzle steer. Astern is weak (40%%). %s FE/s, %s at FLANK. A block skins its hull.
manual.wmd.sub_diesel.title: Sub diesel
manual.wmd.sub_diesel.body: Diesel in, %s FE/s out (busbar). Surfaced it just runs; submerged it needs a raised snorkel on the same ship, or it coughs and stalls. AUTO runs it below half charge. Very loud on sonar.
manual.wmd.snorkel_mast.title: Snorkel mast
manual.wmd.snorkel_mast.body: 1 x 3 mast through the top hull. Raised, the head stands %s blocks over it: the diesels breathe at snorkel depth. AUTO raises it for a diesel. Waves slam the valve. Up = a radar blip + a wake.
tooltip.wmd.ducted_fan: 2 x 2 x 3 airship / jet engine. Runs on power; follows the telegraph / helm, redstone sets its throttle. Exit vanes steer
tooltip.wmd.turbofan: 3 x 3 x 5 jet engine. Power starts it, then it burns jet fuel. Follows the telegraph / helm; the nozzle steers
tooltip.wmd.jato_rack: 1 x 1 x 3 booster rack. Load a JATO booster; BOOST (telegraph past FLANK, helm W at FLANK) or redstone fires it
tooltip.wmd.air.mount: Place it against the face to mount on (under or over a wing, a side); the intake points the way you look
tooltip.wmd.air.skin: Wrench: pod / nacelle. Right-click with a block: the housing takes its look (uses the block; sneak + wrench gives it back)
message.wmd.jato.busy: The rack already holds a booster
message.wmd.telegraph.boost: BOOST: every loaded JATO rack fires
gui.wmd.info.edf_use: Uses %s FE/s turning, up to %s FE/s at FULL
gui.wmd.air.air_rule: Pushes only in air: less high up, none with a wet intake, none past its top speed
gui.wmd.info.tf_use: Starter %s FE/s, then jet fuel (up to %s mB/s at FULL)
gui.wmd.jato.state0: Empty: right-click with a JATO booster
gui.wmd.jato.fire: Fires on BOOST (telegraph one step past FLANK, helm W at FLANK) or a redstone pulse
gui.wmd.jato.rule: A rocket: full thrust at any height, none under water
manual.wmd.engine_damage.title: Engine damage + contrails
manual.wmd.engine_damage.body: Hits wear air engines down. Under %s%%: smoke, %s%% thrust. Under %s%%: fire, %s%% thrust. 0: flameout. Land, use a repair kit. Contrails: above Y %s, over %s b/s.
manual.wmd.ducted_fan.title: Electric ducted fan
manual.wmd.ducted_fan.body: Air drive on power. Plate on the face you click, intake where you look. Telegraph / helm; redstone = throttle. %s FE/s, %s at FULL. Vanes steer. Top speed %s b/s; none if wet. Wrench: pod / nacelle.
manual.wmd.turbofan.title: Turbofan
manual.wmd.turbofan.body: Big jet, placed like the fan. Any order above STOP starts it: the starter takes %s FE/s, then it burns jet fuel (both on the plate). The nozzle steers. Top speed %s b/s. Wet intake or no fuel: flame-out.
manual.wmd.jato_rack.title: JATO rack
manual.wmd.jato_rack.body: Strap-on booster, no power. Right-click with a JATO booster to arm. BOOST (telegraph past FLANK, helm W at FLANK) or redstone fires it: %s s of huge thrust, then the bottle drops (gone in %s s).
tooltip.wmd.air_search_radar: Sees aircraft out to %s blocks (bigger bodies farther): small jets and big airships, one sweep every 2 s. Hostile contacts go to SAM sites on its frequency
tooltip.wmd.power_core: Feeds every WMD block on the same physics ship. Charges from a busbar, its jet fuel APU or Create rotation
tooltip.wmd.copycat_skin: Right-click with a block: the housing takes its look (uses the block; sneak + wrench gives it back)
gui.wmd.info.asr: Sees a 400-block aircraft out to %s blocks; one sweep every %s s
gui.wmd.info.core: Battery %s FE; feeds every WMD block on this ship
manual.wmd.air_search_radar.title: Air Search Radar
manual.wmd.air_search_radar.body: Sees flying ships to %s blocks, one sweep per %s s, %s FE/s. Hills hide them; past %s blocks, so does flying under %s. Hostiles go to SAM sites on its frequency.
manual.wmd.jet_power_core.title: Jet Power Core
manual.wmd.jet_power_core.body: %s FE for every WMD block on its ship. Charges by busbar, the jet fuel APU (%s FE/s below %s %%) or Create rotation.
tooltip.wmd.jet_cockpit: 1 x 2 x 3 fighter cockpit for Sable jets: the tub sits in your fuselage, the bubble canopy on top. Right-click to fly
tooltip.wmd.jet_cockpit_tandem: 1 x 2 x 5 two-seater: the pilot flies, the back seat runs the radar and weapons. Right-click to sit
tooltip.wmd.jet_cockpit.keys: Block on the tub = its look (uses the block). Wrench = glass tint. Redstone out per axis on the rear cell. Seated: C = flight check
message.wmd.cockpit.pilot: Pilot seat: W/S pitch, A/D roll, Q/E yaw, Space/Shift throttle, hold G gun, hold Z to eject
message.wmd.cockpit.wso: Back seat: R lock, X radar, J jammer, 1-4 stations, click fire, F flares
message.wmd.cockpit.no_leave: Too fast to climb out: hold Z to eject
message.wmd.cockpit.no_dispenser: No flare / chaff dispenser aboard yet
message.wmd.cockpit.refit: New ejection seat and canopy fitted
hud.wmd.jet.hints: %s/%s pitch  %s/%s roll  %s/%s yaw  %s/%s throttle  hold %s eject  right-click stand up
manual.wmd.jet_cockpit.title: Jet cockpit
manual.wmd.jet_cockpit.body: Fly a Sable jet. Keys: W/S pitch, A/D roll, Q/E yaw, Space/Shift throttle (hold at 100% = afterburner). HUD + radar need a power core (%s FE/s). Hold Z %s s to eject. Wrench: glass tint.
tooltip.wmd.pylon: Hangs under any block: carries one heat, radar or anti-radiation missile and kicks it clear before the motor lights (it cannot launch above 4 g or upside down), or a sonobuoy / depth charge / T1-T2 torpedo / bomb it drops
tooltip.wmd.launch_rail: 2 blocks: carries TWO heat or radar missiles side by side. They leave the rail at once under their own motor, faster, in any turn or attitude (the dogfight station). Any face (wingtips!)
tooltip.wmd.station.use: Right-click with a missile to load (sneak + empty hand unloads). Fires from the cockpit or on a redstone pulse; a launch takes power from the ship's power core
tooltip.wmd.aam.heat: Short range, heat-seeking: fire and forget, locks only from BEHIND the target (tail cone; wider on afterburner). No warning, only the smoke trail. Flares fool it
tooltip.wmd.aam.radar: Medium range, radar: hold the radar lock until it is 250 blocks from the target. Chaff fools it
tooltip.wmd.aam.arm: Anti-radiation: homes on a radar that is switched on (the locked jet's radar, else the radar nearest the nose). Radar off beats it
tooltip.wmd.aam.agm: Air-to-ground, laser: flies to your laser spot in front of the launcher and hits it with an HE warhead. Smoke breaks the spot
tooltip.wmd.aam.use: Load it into a pylon, a launch rail or a weapons bay (anti-radiation: pylon or bay)
message.wmd.station.full: Already loaded: sneak + empty hand to unload
message.wmd.station.heavy_bay: Only the heavy bomb bay carries that bomb
message.wmd.station.weapons_bay: Only a weapons bay carries the Penetrator
message.wmd.station.heavy_room: A heavy bomb needs a pylon hanging under the wing or fuselage, with the stations beside it empty
message.wmd.station.blocked: No room: a heavy bomb hangs on the pylon beside this one
manual.wmd.air_stations.title: Pylons and Rails
manual.wmd.air_stations.body: On a wing, nose where you look. Load a missile (pylon: or a buoy / charge / torpedo to drop). Redstone fires; heat: a TAIL in %s deg, %s blocks. %s FE.
tooltip.wmd.countermeasure_dispenser: Set it flush into a jet's belly or tail: holds %s flares + %s chaff. Fires from the cockpit, or on redstone (weak signal flares, strong signal chaff)
tooltip.wmd.countermeasure_dispenser.use: Reload on the ground: a flare pack or a chaff pod adds %s
manual.wmd.countermeasure_dispenser.body: Flush in the belly: %s flares + %s chaff. Flares fool heat missiles, chaff radar ones. Redstone 1-7 = flares, 8-15 = chaff. Reload on the ground: +%s per pack or pod.
message.wmd.cockpit.avionics_needed: Weapons need avionics power (a power core aboard)
tooltip.wmd.wing_section: A wing piece that lifts like a sail. Wrench: panel, round leading edge, 45 or 1:2 swept edge, trailing edge, wingtip (left / right). The leading edge points where you look; sneak to place a fin. Sneak + empty hand: thickness (thin / half / full); a Copycats+ copycat layer adds 2 px; a copycat half layer stacks on the top or underside (empty hand takes it off again).
tooltip.wmd.control_surface: A hinged flap: aileron, elevator, rudder, elevon or landing flap (wrench). Follows the cockpit or helm, or a redstone signal (1-15)
message.wmd.wing.thick_max: The wing is already a full block
message.wmd.wing.half_full: No room for another half layer on this side
manual.wmd.wing.title: The WMD Wing
manual.wmd.wing.body: Wing sections lift like sails; the wrench picks the shape. Control surfaces move with the stick: up to %s deg (rudder %s), or redstone. Right-click with a block to skin them.
tooltip.wmd.nose_radar: The jet's own radar, 2 blocks: the back cell sits against the fuselage, the radome sticks out of the clicked face. Runs on the power core; the cockpit's radar button switches it
tooltip.wmd.nose_radar.use: Wrench: pointed radome or flush cap. On the ground, sneak + empty hand opens the radome
message.wmd.nose_radar.flush: The flush cap does not open: wrench it back to the radome first
message.wmd.nose_radar.airborne: Open the radome on the ground
manual.wmd.nose_radar.title: Nose Radar
manual.wmd.nose_radar.body: The jet's radar: sees planes within %s blocks and %s deg of the nose, locks out to %s. Radar missiles need its lock until %s blocks out. %s FE/s from the power core.
tooltip.wmd.weapons_bay: A flush belly bay for one heat, radar or anti-radiation missile (or a light bomb, the heavy Penetrator, a sonobuoy / depth charge / T1-T2 torpedo to drop): closed it hides the missile (a burst cannot shoot it off), to fire the doors open and a trapeze swings it clear
tooltip.wmd.weapons_bay.join: Modules side by side (same direction) join into one 2-4 wide bay with shared doors. The doors face down; sneak while placing to put it against the clicked face
manual.wmd.weapons_bay.title: Weapons Bay
manual.wmd.weapons_bay.body: 1x1x4 in the belly, doors down; side by side up to %s wide. Load a missile, buoy, charge or torpedo; cockpit or redstone: doors, trapeze, away in %s ticks. Closed = safe.
manual.wmd.aam_arm.title: Anti-Radiation Missile
manual.wmd.aam_arm.body: Pylon or bay. Homes on a radar that is ON: your locked jet's, else the one nearest the nose (%s deg, %s blocks). Radar off: it flies to the last spot.
manual.wmd.aam_agm.title: Air-to-Ground Missile
manual.wmd.aam_agm.body: Pylon, rail or bay. Fire at your laser spot (pod, tripod, satellite) within %s deg of the nose, %s blocks. HE warhead.
tooltip.wmd.sam_site: Shoots down jets that an air search radar on its frequency reports as hostile, out to %s blocks. Holds 4 radar missiles
tooltip.wmd.ammo_depot: Holds every kind of ammunition (%s slots). Ordnance loaders within %s blocks draw their rounds from it. Feed it by hand or through the item hatch at the back
tooltip.wmd.ordnance_loader: A flush pit beside or under a parking spot: hangs missiles, bombs, gun ammo and countermeasures on a parked craft, reach %s blocks. Needs an ammo depot within %s blocks
tooltip.wmd.heavy_loader: The big flush loader for ships, subs and bombers: carries every round, heavy bombs and big torpedoes too, reach %s blocks. Needs an ammo depot within %s blocks
tooltip.wmd.loader_track: One flush rail. Lay two lines from a loader (at its wheel gauge) and its carriage drives along them, up to %s blocks
message.wmd.ammo_depot.status: Ammo depot: %s rounds in %s of %s slots
message.wmd.ammo_depot.full: The depot has no room for that
message.wmd.loader.status_idle: Loader: ready, reach %s blocks, track %s blocks. It stocks parked craft when the depot gets the order (sneak + empty hand on the depot). Test cycle: sneak + empty hand here
message.wmd.loader.status_nodepot: Loader: no ammo depot of yours within range (reach %s blocks, track %s blocks)
message.wmd.ammo_depot.order: Stocking order: %s parked craft in range. The loaders take it from here
gui.wmd.loadout.title: Weapon Loadout
gui.wmd.loadout.plan_stock: Plan set. Press STOCK to send the loaders.
gui.wmd.loadout.no_craft: No craft of yours with weapons within range of this depot
gui.wmd.loadout.default_plan: No plan: STOCK fills every station with the first round that fits
gui.wmd.loadout.saved_craft: Plan, presets and groups are saved in the craft's cockpit / helm
gui.wmd.loadout.saved_depot: No cockpit or helm aboard: the plan is kept in this depot
gui.wmd.loadout.group_hint: Pick a group, then click stations to add or remove them
gui.wmd.loadout.tip_click: Click the plan icon: next round. Right-click: no plan
message.wmd.loader.off: Loaders work only with 1.2 Air Battles switched on
message.wmd.loader.blocked: Step off the hatch: the loader will not open with someone standing on it
message.wmd.loader.no_power: The loader needs power (busbar on its east side)
message.wmd.loader.reach: That point is out of the loader's reach
message.wmd.loader.demo: Test cycle: a missile to a point 2.5 blocks north, 2.5 up (nothing is loaded)
message.wmd.loader_track.status: Loader track: lay two lines at the loader's wheel gauge, up to %s blocks long
gui.wmd.info.sam: Range %s blocks; %sk FE a round, %s FE/s while it moves
gui.wmd.info.sam_rounds: Load 4 radar missiles (AAM) into the canisters
gui.wmd.sam.hint.5: Guiding: the radar holds the jet
gui.wmd.sam.hint.8: Needs power: busbar at the back
manual.wmd.sam_site.title: SAM Site
manual.wmd.sam_site.body: Hits jets a radar on its frequency calls hostile, to %s blocks. 4 radar missiles, 2 per target (1: screen), guided to %s blocks out; %s FE a round. Airships: interceptors.
tooltip.wmd.jammer_pod: A radar jammer for jets: while it jams, enemy radars can lock your aircraft only at half range. Runs on the power core; switched on it is a radar signal, so anti-radiation missiles can home on it
tooltip.wmd.jammer_pod.use: Place against any face (the nose points where you look). Cockpit key J, a redstone pulse or right-click switches it on / off; a wrench swaps the pod for a flush panel
message.wmd.jammer_pod.no_ship: on, but not on a ship (needs the power core of a Sable ship)
message.wmd.jammer_pod.no_power: on, but the power core is empty
message.wmd.jammer_pod.to_flush: Flush panel (takes the look of a block you click it with)
message.wmd.jammer_pod.to_pod: Jammer pod on a stub pylon
item.wmd.flight_check_tablet.tip: Right-click a Sable ship (or stand on it): will it fly?
gui.wmd.flightcheck.title: Flight Check
gui.wmd.flightcheck.none: No Sable ship in sight (look at one within %s blocks or stand on it)
gui.wmd.airframe.title: Airframe
gui.wmd.airframe.hint: Drag turn · Wheel zoom · Bar layers
message.wmd.airframe.no_owner: No owned WMD block aboard: place your cockpit first
message.wmd.airframe.not_yours: Not your craft: only its owner and trusted players can read it
message.wmd.airframe.too_big: Too big to record (more than 32,768 blocks)
message.wmd.airframe.relink_fail: That record does not fit this craft
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_heavy_vtol: Too heavy to hover: more lift fans / rotors (or bigger blades), or less weight
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_no_engine: No WMD engine aboard: it cannot fly on WMD power.
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_heavy: Too heavy for its engines: add thrust or lose weight.
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_no_wing: No wings: it only flies on thrust (add wing sections).
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_small_wing: Wings too small: add wing sections or fly faster.
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_no_core: No power core: its WMD blocks will stay dark.
gui.wmd.flightcheck.adv_fuel: Low on fuel: fill the turbofans before take-off.
gui.wmd.flightcheck.note: Estimates; other mods' engines are not counted.
tooltip.wmd.gun_pod: A jet's rotary cannon: fires where the jet points (cockpit trigger or redstone).
tooltip.wmd.gun_pod.use: %s rounds. Reload on the ground with CIWS ammo; wrench: pod or flush look.
message.wmd.gun_pod.to_flush: Flush look: only the muzzle shows
message.wmd.gun_pod.empty: empty (%s / %s): reload on the ground with CIWS ammo
message.wmd.gun_pod.no_ship: %s / %s rounds, not on a Sable ship
message.wmd.gun_pod.land_first: Land first: the gun pod is refilled on the ground (%s / %s)
tooltip.wmd.heavy_gun: A 105 mm gun in a craft's side wall: fires howitzer shells out of a port, aimed from a Gunner Station.
tooltip.wmd.heavy_gun.use: Take a 2x2 hole out of the wall, stand inside, click its floor. %s-round rack: right-click with howitzer shells (in flight too).
message.wmd.heavy_gun.wrong_shell: Only howitzer shells (not canister) fit this gun
message.wmd.heavy_gun.hand_loaded: Loaded into the breech (%s / %s in the rack)
manual.wmd.heavy_gun.title: Gunship Heavy Gun
manual.wmd.heavy_gun.body: A 105 mm in the side wall: hole 2x2, click its floor from inside. Howitzer shells or 105 mm Gunship HE, rack %s. Aim from a Gunner Station (H). Range %s.
tooltip.wmd.deck_gun: A 127 mm in a turning gunhouse, its ring flush in the deck (3x3x3: the bottom layer is the deck).
tooltip.wmd.deck_gun.use: Howitzer shells (not canister): %s in the drum + 1 in the breech. Right-click with a shell to load.
tooltip.wmd.battleship_turret: Three long barrels on a 5x5 ring flush in the deck (5x5x5: the bottom two layers sit in the hull).
tooltip.wmd.battleship_turret.use: %s shells (howitzer shells or the super gun HE as a heavy round) + super charges. Right-click to load.
tooltip.wmd.naval_gun.aim: Aim by eye from a Gunner Station (aircraft too) or from the fire control console's GUNS page. Ships only.
message.wmd.naval_gun.wrong_xl: Only howitzer shells (not canister), super gun HE shells and super charges.
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.lead: Led: the guns aim where it will be
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.t_how: Pick a contact (TORPEDO) or type X Z (STRIKE)
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.air: Aircraft: by eye from a Gunner Station
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.how: Deck guns + turrets on this console's ship show here
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.label: D%s
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.hint_fire: FIRE = the selected gun, SALVO = all + tubes
gui.wmd.fcc.gun.no_target: No target: pick a contact or type X Z.
manual.wmd.naval_guns.title: Naval Deck Guns
manual.wmd.naval_guns.body: Deck gun: a 3x3 hole in the deck, click its floor. %s rounds; by eye %s, by console %s. Turret: 5x5x2 hole, %s shells + %s charges, %s; heavy round to %s.
tooltip.wmd.gun_turret: A 30 mm chain gun that hides flush in a craft's skin and comes out when a gunner takes it.
tooltip.wmd.gun_turret.use: %s rounds, +%s per CIWS ammo box on the ground. Fit it into the hull from outside: it never fires into its own craft.
tooltip.wmd.gunner_station: A crew seat with a gun camera: aim the craft's gun turrets.
tooltip.wmd.gunner_station.use: Sit down: mouse aims, attack fires, wheel zooms, L locks a point, R next turret, K pod view, sneak stands up.
message.wmd.gun_turret.empty: empty (%s / %s): reload on the ground with CIWS ammo
message.wmd.gun_turret.no_ship: %s / %s rounds, not on a Sable craft
message.wmd.gun_turret.land_first: Land first: the turret is refilled on the ground (%s / %s)
message.wmd.gunner.taken: Someone already sits at this station
message.wmd.gunner.no_craft: Gunner station: not on a Sable craft, there is nothing to aim
message.wmd.gunner.seated: Gunner: mouse aims, attack fires, wheel zooms, L locks, R next turret, K pod view
hud.wmd.gunner.title: GUNNER
death.attack.wmd.gun_turret: %1$s was cut down by a gun turret
death.attack.wmd.gun_turret.player: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's gun turret
manual.wmd.gunner.title: Gunner + Turret
manual.wmd.gunner.body: Turret flush in the hull, station inside. Sit: mouse aims, attack fires, R next, K pod. Never hits its own craft. %s rounds, +%s per CIWS box. Range %s.
manual.wmd.gun_pod.title: Gun Pod
manual.wmd.gun_pod.body: Jet cannon, any face; wrench: pod / flush. Fires ahead (trigger, redstone). %s rounds, +%s per CIWS ammo box on the ground. Reach %s.
tooltip.wmd.targeting_pod: A jet's laser designator: lights a laser spot where the pilot looks, for laser bombs, AGMs and laser shells.
tooltip.wmd.targeting_pod.use: Cockpit key: lase / clear (up to %s blocks). Wrench: pod or flush look.
message.wmd.tpod.to_flush: Flush look: only the sensor ball shows
message.wmd.tpod.no_ground: Nothing to lase there (sky, too far or not loaded)
message.wmd.tpod.no_view: The targeting pod cannot see that spot
message.wmd.tpod.no_power: Targeting pod: no charge in the power core
message.wmd.tpod.tracking: POD: TRACKING (the laser follows the target)
manual.wmd.targeting_pod.title: Targeting Pod
manual.wmd.targeting_pod.body: Jet laser designator, any face; wrench: pod / flush. Cockpit key lases where you look (%s blocks) while the ball sees it: for laser bombs, AGMs, shells.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear: A retractable gear well for the belly: the leg and wheel fold out when it is down. Works on runways and ship decks.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear.use: Cockpit gear key or a redstone signal: down. Down and locked = redstone out. Wrench: nose (steers) / main / twin / canted main. Empty hand: small or medium (F-22 size) wheel; twin works with both.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear_large: 2 x 1 x 1 gear well for heavy planes (AC-130 size wheel): the leg folds sideways into the second block.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear_large.use: Cockpit gear key or a redstone signal: down. Wrench: nose (steers) / main.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear_bogie: 1 x 1 x 2 gear well for heavy transports (C-130 / C-17 style): big wheels on a walking beam that rises straight up into the well. Carries a bigger share of the weight and takes harder landings.
tooltip.wmd.landing_gear_bogie.use: Cockpit gear key or a redstone signal: down. Wrench: tandem (2 wheels, on the side away from the middle of the craft) / quad (4 wheels). Place it looking forward: the second block goes behind.
tooltip.wmd.tow_bar: Telescopic tow bar: move a parked craft by hand, on the ground, a carrier deck or a deck lift.
tooltip.wmd.tow_bar.use: Right-click a NOSE landing gear to hook up (the bar takes the length you stand at). Walk back to pull, walk on to push; the nose wheel follows the bar. Use it again to let go.
message.wmd.wrench.mode_rotate: Wrench: ROTATE mode (turns machines; sneak + right-click the air for USE)
message.wmd.wrench.mode_use: Wrench: USE mode (each block's own wrench action; sneak + right-click the air for ROTATE)
message.wmd.gear.wow: Gear up refused: weight on wheels
message.wmd.tow.on: Tow bar on (%s blocks): walk back to pull, walk on to push. Use it again to let go
message.wmd.tow.not_nose: The tow bar only fits a NOSE gear (wrench the gear to nose)
message.wmd.tow.not_craft: This gear is not on a craft
message.wmd.tow.not_ground: The nose wheel must be down and standing on something
message.wmd.tow.too_far: Too far from the nose wheel
message.wmd.tow.seated: Get out first: you cannot tow from a seat
message.wmd.tow.throttle: The throttle is not at idle: the pilot is driving
message.wmd.tow.pilot: The pilot took over: tow bar off
message.wmd.tow.airborne: The craft left the ground: tow bar off
message.wmd.tow.slipped: You walked too far: the tow bar slipped off
message.wmd.tow.gear_gone: The nose gear is gone or raised: tow bar off
manual.wmd.landing_gear.title: Landing Gear
manual.wmd.landing_gear.body: Belly gear well, any face; wrench: role, empty hand: wheel size. Gear key or redstone: down (%s s cycle). Brakes on the mains; the nose steers. Heavy planes: large or bogie gear (carries more weight).
manual.wmd.tow_bar.title: Tow Bar + Reverse Taxi
manual.wmd.tow_bar.body: Right-click a NOSE gear: walk back = pull, walk on = push (%s b/s max). Deck and lift too. Cockpit: hold Left Ctrl at idle to roll back (%s b/s), Q / E steer.
tooltip.wmd.tailhook: Flush in the tail belly, stowed by default: hold the gear key (V) in the cockpit (or give it a redstone signal) to drop the hook; it reaches below the wheels and catches an arresting wire on a deck.
tooltip.wmd.heli_rotor: 1 x 1 x 1 on the roof: the main rotor. A turboshaft aboard drives it; fly it from the jet cockpit: throttle = collective, W/S/A/D tilt it, it holds level and in place when you let go.
tooltip.wmd.heli_rotor.use: Stopped: wrench = blade length 7 / 11 / 15, empty hand = 2 / 3 / 4 blades, sneak + wrench = fold the blades, sneak + empty hand = steel skin. Two heads aboard = tandem (no tail rotor needed).
tooltip.wmd.heli_tail: 1 x 1 x 1 in the tail boom, rotor on its side: Q / E turn the helicopter. Driven by the turboshaft.
tooltip.wmd.heli_tail.use: Place it looking forward; the rotor turns on its right side.
tooltip.wmd.heli_turboshaft: 1 x 1 x 2 buried in the fuselage: drives every rotor head and tail rotor aboard while the throttle is up.
tooltip.wmd.heli_turboshaft.use: Runs on the Jet Power Core (no busbar). Intake at the front, exhaust stack on top.
message.wmd.heli.no_drive: no drive (a turboshaft aboard must run)
message.wmd.heli.turbo_off: off (throttle up in the jet cockpit)
manual.wmd.helicopter.title: Helicopter
manual.wmd.helicopter.body: A turboshaft drives the rotors. Throttle = climb (50% holds), W/S fly, A/D turn, Q/E slide, let go = hover. Wrench: %s/%s/%s blades. 2 heads = tandem.
tooltip.wmd.cargo_hook_light: 1 x 1 x 1, flush in the belly: a hook on a 16-block wire rope picks up mobs, players, vehicles or another Sable craft (up to about a car) and carries it swinging under you.
tooltip.wmd.cargo_hook_light.use: Jet cockpit: tap L to lower / raise, hold L to release (or a redstone pulse).
tooltip.wmd.cargo_hook_heavy: 2 x 1 x 2, flush in the belly: a big hook on a 32-block wire rope; lifts up to about a small boat. A load too heavy will not lift off.
tooltip.wmd.cargo_hook_heavy.use: Jet cockpit: tap L to lower / raise, hold L to release (or a redstone pulse).
tooltip.wmd.drogue_pod: 1 x 1 x 2 under a wing or the belly: streams a hose with a basket behind your tanker; another jet's refuel probe in the basket takes jet fuel from your power cores.
tooltip.wmd.drogue_pod.use: Place it looking forward. Jet cockpit P = refuel mode (the hose reels out). Lamps: amber ready, green fuel flowing, red stop.
tooltip.wmd.refuel_probe: 1 x 1 x 1 in the nose: slides out in refuel mode; fly its tip into a tanker's basket to take on jet fuel.
tooltip.wmd.refuel_probe.use: Place it looking forward. Jet cockpit P = refuel mode (the probe slides out / in).
message.wmd.refuel.on: Refuel mode ON (pods stream, probes out)
tooltip.wmd.nav_light: Nav red / green / white, strobe, red beacon or landing light. Place it on any face, also on a wing: it sits on the wing's skin.
tooltip.wmd.nav_light.use: Right-click: function, spot, on / off / auto, brightness. Wrench: next function.
gui.wmd.navlight.hint_auto: Auto: on while the craft's avionics run.
gui.wmd.navlight.hint_auto_strobe: Auto: avionics on and an engine running.
gui.wmd.navlight.hint_auto_landing: Auto: avionics on and the gear down.
manual.wmd.aircraft_light.title: Aircraft Light
manual.wmd.aircraft_light.body: Place it on any face: on a wing it sits on the skin. Click near an edge of the face for that spot. Auto follows the avionics (strobe: an engine too, landing: the gear down).
tooltip.wmd.fuel_tank: 1 x 1 x 1, 4,000 mB jet fuel inside your airframe. It joins the craft's one fuel pool: power cores, jet engines and refueling use it without pipes.
tooltip.wmd.fuel_tank.use: Fill it by pipe on the front face while parked. The gauge on top shows the level. Right-click it with a block to skin it.
tooltip.wmd.drop_tank: 1 x 1 x 3 external tank under a wing or the belly, 12,000 mB jet fuel in the craft's fuel pool. Used before the internal fuel.
tooltip.wmd.drop_tank.use: Place it looking forward; fill it by pipe on the top of the front cell. Jet cockpit O jettisons every drop tank (the fuel in them is lost).
message.wmd.fuel_tank.gone: jettisoned (empty pylon: break it and place it again)
gui.wmd.stores.title: Stores
manual.wmd.cargo_hook.title: Cargo hooks
manual.wmd.cargo_hook.body: Belly hook: L lowers / raises, hold L to drop. It grabs what it touches. Light ~ a car, heavy ~ a boat.
manual.wmd.refuel.title: Air-to-air refueling
manual.wmd.refuel.body: Both jets press P. Fly the probe tip into the tanker's basket: green = fuel flows.
tooltip.wmd.turboprop: 1 x 1 x 3 nacelle, the propeller turns in front of it: pulls hard but tops out at about 45 blocks per second. Runs on the jet power core.
tooltip.wmd.turboprop.use: Place it looking forward. Wrench (stopped): 3 / 4 / 6 blades or contra-rotating. Sneak + empty hand: boxed / bare.
tooltip.wmd.tiltrotor: 1 x 1 x 2 wingtip pod with a 5-block rotor. Hover mode (cockpit key U) tilts it up to lift, leaving hover tilts it forward to fly. Use them in pairs.
tooltip.wmd.tiltrotor.use: Place it looking forward on a wingtip. Runs on the jet power core.
tooltip.wmd.ship_turbine: 2 x 2 x 4 marine gas turbine below decks: drives every waterjet aboard. Burns diesel or jet fuel piped into its fuel port on top.
tooltip.wmd.ship_turbine.use: A busbar on its socket runs the starter; once lit it runs on fuel while the helm or telegraph is off STOP.
message.wmd.ship_turbine.no_fuel: no fuel: pipe diesel or jet fuel into the port on top
message.wmd.ship_turbine.off: off (fuel %2$s mB): set the helm or telegraph ahead
tooltip.wmd.waterjet: 1 x 1 x 3, flush in the stern bottom: the intake under the front, the nozzle on the back. Fast and loud; the nozzle steers with the rudder, a bucket drops for astern.
tooltip.wmd.waterjet.use: Place it looking forward. Needs a running ship gas turbine aboard. Wrench: boxed / bare.
message.wmd.waterjet.dry: running dry: the intake is out of the water
message.wmd.waterjet.no_drive: no drive (a ship gas turbine aboard must run)
tooltip.wmd.azimuth_pod: 2 x 1 x 2 in the hull bottom: a propeller pod hangs below and turns all the way round with the rudder (astern: it swings round). Needs about 5 blocks of room below.
tooltip.wmd.azimuth_pod.use: Place it looking forward. Power: a busbar on its socket.
tooltip.wmd.bow_thruster: 1 x 1 x 1 tunnel through the bow, below the waterline: pushes the bow sideways for docking while you hold the helm's bow keys (Z / C).
tooltip.wmd.bow_thruster.use: Place it looking forward. Power: a busbar on top (a hull penetrator above it keeps the deck watertight).
message.wmd.p6.no_core: no power: the ship needs a charged jet power core
message.wmd.p6.no_power: no power: a busbar on its socket
manual.wmd.turboprop.title: Turboprop + tilt-rotor
manual.wmd.turboprop.body: Power core. Turboprop: tops out at %s b/s, wrench (stopped) = blades. Tilt-rotors in pairs: U = hover.
manual.wmd.ship_drives.title: Ship drives
manual.wmd.ship_drives.body: Gas turbine drives the waterjets. Pod + bow thruster: busbar. Helm Z / C: bow thrusters.
tooltip.wmd.lift_fan: 3 x 1 x 3, flush behind the cockpit: an F-35B style lift fan. Hover mode (cockpit key U) with a jet engine running aboard: it lifts, the throttle sets the height and it keeps the jet level.
tooltip.wmd.lift_fan.use: Place it looking towards the jet engine that drives it. W / S tilt the louvres to creep forward or back. The jet engines give 30%% less forward thrust while it lifts.
message.wmd.lift.no_jet: hover on, but no jet engine aboard is running
message.wmd.lift.hover_on: Hover mode ON: the lift fan takes over (throttle = height)
tooltip.wmd.drag_chute: 1 x 1 x 1, flush in the tail, facing the nose: pops a braking parachute on cockpit key N (over the landing roll speed; above 50 b/s it tears away).
tooltip.wmd.drag_chute.use: Right-click with an empty hand after landing to repack it.
message.wmd.chute.spent: spent: right-click with an empty hand to repack
manual.wmd.lift_fan.title: Lift fan + drag chute
manual.wmd.lift_fan.body: U: hover. A running jet engine drives the fan: throttle = height, it stays level, W/S creep. Engines: %s%% thrust. Chute: key N over %s b/s.
tooltip.wmd.arresting_wire: Place two in a straight line across a deck, same height (up to %s blocks apart; they turn to face each other): the cable between them catches a jet's tailhook. Power it with a busbar under either sheave.
message.wmd.wire.no_partner: no partner: place a second one in a straight line across the deck, same height, 2-%2$s blocks away (they turn to face each other)
message.wmd.wire.paired: paired: the other sheave runs the cable (a busbar under either one powers it)
tooltip.wmd.catapult_track: Steam catapult segments, flush in a deck: a line of %s-%s; the rear one holds the shuttle. Nose wheel on the shuttle + full throttle (or redstone) = launch at %s b/s.
message.wmd.catapult.segment: track segment (the rear segment of a line of %3$s+ is the catapult)
message.wmd.catapult.no_power: Catapult: not charged (busbar under the track)
tooltip.wmd.deck_light: A flush deck or runway light. Wrench: blue edge, white centreline, red, green, landing beacon. Redstone: off.
message.wmd.deck_light.mode4: LANDING BEACON: a %s deg glideslope on the HUD of jets coming in against it
manual.wmd.carrier_ops.title: Carrier Operations
manual.wmd.carrier_ops.body: Catapult: %s-%s track blocks, nose wheel on the shuttle, full throttle: %s b/s. Wire: 2 sheaves stop a tailhook in %s blocks.
tooltip.wmd.deck_lift: Lift tiles join into a platform of %s x %s up to %s x %s blocks in a deck; it drops up to %s blocks down its shaft (air under it).
tooltip.wmd.deck_lift.use: Right-click a tile with an empty hand (or redstone at the corner tile) to send it down / up. Busbar on the corner tile's west face. A block on a tile = the platform's look.
tooltip.wmd.turntable: Turntable tiles join into a square of %s x %s up to %s x %s in a floor; the round plate inside it turns a parked jet.
tooltip.wmd.turntable.use: Right-click a tile: the turn screen (redstone at the corner tile repeats the last order). Busbar under the corner tile. A block on a tile = the floor's look.
message.wmd.turntable.no_head: Not part of a whole square
message.wmd.turntable.two_crafts: Two craft on it: one at a time
message.wmd.turntable.wheel_off: A wheel is off the plate
message.wmd.turntable.not_on_wheels: The craft is not on all its wheels
message.wmd.turntable.already: The nose already points that way
message.wmd.turntable.status_idle: %s x %s, heading %s°, a 90° turn %s FE, stored %s FE
message.wmd.turntable.status_not_square: not a whole square (%6$s x %6$s to %7$s x %7$s tiles)
gui.wmd.turntable.heading: Plate heading %s° (to %s°)
message.wmd.lift.no_head: This lift has no corner tile (the tile with no lift tile west or north of it)
message.wmd.lift.not_rect: Not a full rectangle of lift tiles (5 x 5 to 48 x 48) with open air under it
message.wmd.lift.half_on: Refused: a ship stands half on the lift
message.wmd.lift.blocked: Refused: the shaft under the lift is blocked
message.wmd.lift.no_power: Not enough charge for the trip (busbar on the corner tile)
message.wmd.lift.status_not_rect: not a full rectangle (%6$s-%7$s a side)
manual.wmd.deck_lift.title: Deck Lift
manual.wmd.deck_lift.body: Tiles make a %s-%s square platform in a deck over an open shaft (down %s). Empty hand or redstone: down / up. Busbar: corner tile, west.
manual.wmd.turntable.title: Hangar Turntable
manual.wmd.turntable.body: A %s-%s tile square in a floor; the plate is the circle inside. All wheels on it, throttle idle. Screen or deck console: 90 (%s s) / 180 / nose N E S W. Busbar: under the corner.
manual.wmd.flight_check.title: Flight Check
manual.wmd.flight_check.body: Right-click a Sable ship within %s blocks (or stand on it), or open it in the cockpit: mass, thrust-to-weight (under %s%%: too heavy), lift, stall speed, power, fuel.
tooltip.wmd.survey_scanner: Flush in a hangar ceiling or wall: checks your recorded craft parked within 24 blocks
tooltip.wmd.survey_scanner.use: Right-click: the airframe page. Comparator: the number of faults. Needs busbar power
message.wmd.survey_scanner.none: no recorded craft of yours parked within %s blocks
manual.wmd.survey_scanner.title: Hangar Survey Scanner
manual.wmd.survey_scanner.body: Place it in a hangar ceiling or wall, busbar on its back. It scans your recorded craft parked within %s blocks: comparator = faults. Right-click: the airframe page.
manual.wmd.loadout.title: Weapon loadout
manual.wmd.loadout.body: AMMO DEPOT: all ammunition, serves loaders within %s blocks. ORDNANCE LOADER: a flush pit by a parking spot, reach %s. HEAVY LOADER (ships, bombers): reach %s, every round. Two LOADER TRACK lines (up to %s) let one drive along.
manual.wmd.loadout_screen.title: Loadout screen
manual.wmd.loadout_screen.body: Right-click the depot. Click a plan icon to choose a round; shift-drag selects many. Save up to %s presets. STOCK loads the plan, UNLOAD brings rounds back. Groups = cockpit keys 1-4.
tooltip.wmd.gantry_rail: A crane runway on the hangar wall: two lines facing each other carry the repair gantry
tooltip.wmd.gantry_rail.use: Place from inside the hangar (the wall goes behind it); lines 3-64 long, 5-50 apart
tooltip.wmd.gantry_cabinet: The repair gantry's parts store and screen: place it against the wall under one rail line
tooltip.wmd.gantry_cabinet.use: Puts back missing blocks, skins and settings of a recorded craft parked between the rails
message.wmd.gantry_rail.hint: Two rail lines facing each other + a Gantry Cabinet under one of them = a repair gantry
gui.wmd.gantry.hint_hatch.0: Run the rail line right above
manual.wmd.gantry.title: Repair gantry
manual.wmd.gantry.body: Rails on two hangar walls %s-%s apart, cabinet under one. Park a recorded craft between, fill the cabinet, Start: blocks, skins, settings go back. %s FE/t.
manual.wmd.airframe.title: Airframe record
manual.wmd.airframe.body: Flight Check Tablet > Airframe: record your healthy craft. Later its 3D view shows missing blocks red, broken ones amber, and a parts list. Show in world outlines them for %s s.
manual.wmd.air_guns.title: Guns vs Jets
manual.wmd.air_guns.body: A CIWS on an air search radar's frequency fires at hostile jets to %s blocks. Small fast jets are hard to hit; each hit breaks a hull block. Flak bursting near a jet adds fragments.
manual.wmd.jammer_pod.title: Jammer Pod
manual.wmd.jammer_pod.body: Any face; wrench = pod or flush panel. Key J, redstone or a click: on / off. Jamming, enemy radars lock you only at %s%% range. %s FE/s from the power core. ON = an ARM target.
message.wmd.cockpit.jam_on: Jammer ON: enemy radars lock you only at half range
key.wmd.jet.reverse: Reverse taxi (hold, on the wheels at idle)
message.wmd.agm.laser: AGM: LASER (flies to your laser spot ahead)
message.wmd.agm.gps: AGM: GPS (fire and forget at the pod spot / a laser spot / your command center target)
hud.wmd.podcam.title: TGT POD
hud.wmd.podcam.hint: %s lase / track / clear   left click fire   wheel zoom   %s: back
tooltip.wmd.seeker.radar: An active radar head for the radar-guided jet missile: assembly bay, Air mode only (T3 airframe)
tooltip.wmd.aam.refined: Refined warhead: +%s%% blast radius and power
gui.wmd.bay.mode_airframe.6: Air: heat / laser seeker = T2 parts, radar / anti-radiation = T3; frag warhead (laser: HE)
gui.wmd.bay.air_seeker: Put a seeker in the seeker slot: it decides the jet missile
gui.wmd.bay.radar_seeker_air: The radar seeker only fits the Air mode
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.0: Ballistic missile: T1-T3 airframe, any warhead
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.1: T4 core stage: T4 airframe + T4 motor
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.2: T4 upper stage: all four T4 parts
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.4: Cruise missile: T2-T3 airframe, the jet engine, a ground warhead
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.5: SLBM: T3 airframe, plain T3 motor, a ground warhead
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.6: Jet missiles, 2 per run: the seeker decides (heat / radar / anti-radiation / laser)
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.size: Needs line size %s (this line: %s): add extensions on the Line tab
gui.wmd.bay.mtip.busy: The line is building: change the mode when it is idle
gui.wmd.bay.air_tip_seeker: Put a seeker here: it picks the missile
jei.wmd.bay.air: Air mode: the seeker decides the jet missile; 2 per run, a refined warhead makes refined missiles
manual.wmd.bay_air.title: Bay: Air mode
manual.wmd.bay_air.body: Air mode: the seeker picks the jet missile. Heat / laser: T2 parts, radar / anti-rad: T3. Frag warhead (laser: HE). %s per run; refined warhead: +%s%% blast.
message.wmd.screw.no_tail: Tail: none (the screw only pushes; steer with your own rudders)
tooltip.wmd.single_jet: 1 x 1 x 4, buried in the fuselage (F-16 style): 2,400 thrust, 4,800 on afterburner
tooltip.wmd.twin_jet: 3 x 1 x 4: two engines with a keel between them (F-15 / F-22 / F-117 V): 4,800 thrust, 9,600 on afterburner
tooltip.wmd.stealth_jet: 5 x 1 x 4 (F-117 style): grille intakes, one flat slot exhaust: 4,000 thrust, no afterburner, heat seekers lock it at half range
tooltip.wmd.jet.use: Place it looking towards the nose. Fuel and starter power come from the Jet Power Core: no pipes, no cable
tooltip.wmd.jet.style: Wrench or sneak + empty hand: boxed / bare
tooltip.wmd.jet.style_twin: Wrench: round, vectoring or V nozzles. Sneak + empty hand: boxed / bare
manual.wmd.jet_engines.title: Jet engines
manual.wmd.jet_engines.body: Face the nose. Core: fuel + start. Single %s, twin %s (x2 AB), stealth %s.
tooltip.wmd.service_arm: 3 x 3 x 7 deck-pit arm: refuels and charges a parked Sable craft up to 15 blocks away. Sink it in a 3-deep pit: the lid is level with the deck
tooltip.wmd.service_arm.use: Pipe jet fuel (west) and diesel (east) and a busbar (middle) into the south face, bottom row. Couples onto a Service Receptacle, else an open fuel port
tooltip.wmd.service_receptacle: 1 x 1 x 1 refuel + ground-power point for the skin of your craft: place it with its door looking out of the hull. The Service Arm couples onto it
message.wmd.service_receptacle.open: door open, an arm is coming in
gui.wmd.info.service_arm: Reach %s blocks, fuel %s mB/s, ground power %s FE/s
gui.wmd.sarm.points: Fuel points in reach: %s (click one to pin it)
gui.wmd.sarm.pinned: Pinned: the arm serves only that point
gui.wmd.sarm.auto_pick: Picks a receptacle first, then the nearest
manual.wmd.service_arm.title: Service arm
manual.wmd.service_arm.body: Refuels + charges your parked craft up to %s blocks out: a Service Receptacle first, else an open fuel port. %s mB/s, %s FE/s; %s FE/s moving.
tooltip.wmd.rocket_pod: Unguided rockets for planes and helicopters: hang it under a wing or a stub, or set it flush in the hull.
tooltip.wmd.rocket_pod.use: %s tubes. Reload on the ground with 70 mm rockets; wrench: pod or flush look. Fires on the cockpit trigger, a firing group or redstone.
tooltip.wmd.air_rocket: An unguided 70 mm rocket for the rocket pod.
tooltip.wmd.air_rocket.use: Right-click a parked rocket pod with it, or stock it from the ammo depot.
message.wmd.rocket_pod.land_first: Land first: rocket pods are reloaded on the ground
message.wmd.rocket_pod.busy: The rocket pod is busy (firing or loading)
message.wmd.rocket_pod.to_flush: Rocket pod: flush look (tray in the hull)
message.wmd.rocket_pod.to_pod: Rocket pod: pod look (on a stub)
log.wmd.rocket_salvo: Rocket salvo: %s rockets, %s on a craft, near %s %s
tooltip.wmd.art_shell.gunship: Gunship heavy gun only: a big HE blast (crater 6, breaks ships)
manual.wmd.rocket_pod.title: Rocket Pod
manual.wmd.rocket_pod.body: Unguided rockets, any face; wrench: pod / flush tray. %s tubes, %s rockets a craft, reload on the ground. Groups, redstone. Pipper: %s-%s.
tooltip.wmd.hangar_door: One per column in the top row of the opening, placed from inside looking out: %s-%s tiles side by side join into one roller shutter at any height, and every column rolls down to its own floor (up to %s blocks)
tooltip.wmd.hangar_door.use: Click: open / close. Redstone on any tile: on = open, off = close. A block in hand: the hood's look (click a tile) or the slats' look (click the curtain). Busbar on the inside face of the left end tile
message.wmd.hdoor.no_head: Not part of a hangar door
message.wmd.hdoor.off: Air battles content is switched off
message.wmd.hdoor.not_run: A hangar door needs 3 to 45 drum tiles side by side
message.wmd.hdoor.status_0: not a door yet: needs %5$s to %6$s drum tiles side by side (%1$s now)
message.wmd.hdoor.status_1: OPEN, %1$s columns, up to %2$s blocks high, %3$s FE stored (%4$s FE a cell)
message.wmd.hdoor.status_2: CLOSED, %1$s columns, up to %2$s blocks high, %3$s FE stored (%4$s FE a cell)
message.wmd.hdoor.status_3: STOPPED part way, %1$s columns: click to finish
message.wmd.hdoor.status_6: WAITING: something is in the way under the door. It carries on by itself once the way is clear
message.wmd.hdoor.status_7: WAITING for power: %3$s FE stored, %4$s FE a cell
tooltip.wmd.cargo_ramp: Build it into the tail wall from inside, looking out: tiles join %s-%s wide x %s-%s high into one ramp. The bottom 3 rows are the ramp (wrench: 2-4), the rows above the upper door
tooltip.wmd.cargo_ramp.use: Cockpit Y: open / close (hold Y: drop the pallets). Right-click: the ramp panel. A block in hand: its skin. Redstone pulse: the next pallet
tooltip.wmd.cargo_pallet.how: Place it on the hold floor in front of a cargo ramp, fill it, then drop it in flight: it comes down under a parachute
tooltip.wmd.cargo_pallet_heavy.how: 2 x 2 blocks, two compartments, three chutes. Needs a ramp at least 2 wide
message.wmd.ramp.no_head: This ramp tile has no head tile (bottom-left, seen from inside)
message.wmd.ramp.off: Air Battles content is switched off on this server
message.wmd.ramp.not_rect: Not a whole ramp: the tiles must make a rectangle 2-7 wide and 2-6 high in one wall
message.wmd.ramp.no_power: Not enough power to open the ramp (aboard a craft the power core charges it; on the ground a busbar on the head tile)
message.wmd.ramp.not_open: The ramp is not open yet
message.wmd.ramp.lane_empty: No pallets in front of the ramp
message.wmd.ramp.static_on: Static line: on (jumpers get a chute)
message.wmd.ramp.status_0: CLOSED, %1$s x %2$s (ramp %3$s rows, door %4$s), lane: %5$s light + %6$s heavy pallets
message.wmd.ramp.status_3: OPEN (on the ground), lane: %5$s light + %6$s heavy pallets
message.wmd.ramp.status_4: not a whole rectangle (2-7 wide x 2-6 high, every tile)
message.wmd.pallet.no_depot: None of your Ammo Depots is within %s blocks
message.wmd.pallet.unpacked: %s rounds moved into your Ammo Depot
message.wmd.pallet.no_ammo: Nothing here that the Ammo Depot takes
gui.wmd.pallet.tab.unpack: Unpack: the ammo into your Ammo Depot (within %s blocks)
gui.wmd.ramp.hint: Open = level in flight, ground when parked
manual.wmd.cargo_ramp.title: Cargo Ramp + Drop Pallets
manual.wmd.cargo_ramp.body: Tail-wall tiles, %s-%s wide: cockpit Y opens (level in flight, onto the ground parked), hold Y drops the pallets in front. Chute %s b/t; jump %s+ up: static line.
tooltip.wmd.ashm.stats: Range %s blocks, %s blocks/s, skims the sea, HE warhead
tooltip.wmd.ashm.use: Pylon or weapons bay. Lock a ship with the nose radar in SEA mode (X), or fire it straight ahead: its own radar takes the biggest ship it finds.
message.wmd.ashm.away.lock: Anti-ship missile away at %1$s (radar lock): %2$s blocks, %3$s s
message.wmd.ashm.away.pod: Anti-ship missile away at %1$s (pod spot): %2$s blocks, %3$s s
message.wmd.ashm.away.designated: Anti-ship missile away at %1$s (designated ship): %2$s blocks, %3$s s
message.wmd.ashm.away.bearing: Anti-ship missile away on the bearing (no lock: its seeker takes the biggest ship ahead): %2$s blocks, %3$s s
log.wmd.ashm_decoyed: Your anti-ship missile was pulled off by chaff near %s %s
manual.wmd.ashm.title: Anti-Ship Missile
manual.wmd.ashm.body: %s a run. X twice: radar SEA, R locks a ship; no lock: biggest ship ahead. %s b/s, %s blocks, seen at %s.
tooltip.wmd.anchor_windlass: Holds a ship at anchor in up to %s blocks of water; an anchored ship counts as parked
tooltip.wmd.anchor_windlass.use: Right-click: screen. The hawse is front-left: stack Hawse Pipes under it
tooltip.wmd.hawse_pipe: Stack up to %s under an anchor windlass to lead the chain through the hull
message.wmd.anchor.gated: Anchors are part of the air battles content (off)
message.wmd.anchor.blocked: Hawse blocked: the cell under the hawse (or the last pipe) must be open
message.wmd.anchor.pipe: Hawse Pipe: the chain of the windlass above runs through here
gui.wmd.anchor.p_blocked: Hawse blocked under the last pipe
gui.wmd.anchor.p_no_power: No power: busbar or the ship core
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_stowed: Drop: holds in up to 64 m of water
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_dropping: The chain runs out to the seabed
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_holding: Holding: the ship counts as parked
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_dragging: Dragging: throttle back to let it dig in
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_weighing: Hauling the ship over its anchor
gui.wmd.anchor.hint_no_bottom: Too deep: weigh, find shallower water
manual.wmd.anchor_windlass.title: Anchor Windlass
manual.wmd.anchor_windlass.body: Drop: the anchor holds in up to %s blocks of water and the ship counts as parked. Over half throttle it drags. Up to %s Hawse Pipes under the hawse. Weigh: %s FE/t.
tooltip.wmd.deck_console: One screen for the deck and the air wing within %s blocks: lifts, catapults, wires, lights, ramps and your parked craft
tooltip.wmd.deck_console.use: Right-click: the console (owner + trusted). A block in hand: its skin. Busbar on the back, or the ship's power core
manual.wmd.deck_console.title: Flight Deck Console
manual.wmd.deck_console.body: Sees %s blocks of its own deck. DECK: lift, Launch, ramps, light colours (pick on map). AIR WING: your parked craft, Fuel / Arm / Fix. %s FE/t open, folds %s s after.
message.wmd.deck_console.gated: Air battles are switched off on this server
message.wmd.deck_console.folded: The screen is still folding out
message.wmd.deck_console.gone: That is not there any more
message.wmd.deck_console.denied: You may not use that block
message.wmd.deck_console.not_hooked: No jet is hooked to that catapult
message.wmd.deck_console.far: That is out of the console's range
message.wmd.deck_console.not_owner: That craft is not the console owner's
message.wmd.deck_console.no_arm: No service arm reaches that craft
message.wmd.deck_console.no_depot: No ammo depot reaches that craft
message.wmd.deck_console.fixing: The gantry is already repairing it
message.wmd.deck_console.no_gantry: No repair gantry has that craft under its rails
message.wmd.deck_console.no_door: Hangar doors are not available yet
gui.wmd.deck_console.hint_deck: Click or drag over lights to pick them, then a colour below.
gui.wmd.deck_console.hint_deck2: Owner + trusted. Every button uses that block's own controls.
gui.wmd.deck_console.hint_wing: Fuel = service arm   Arm = depot Stock   Fix = repair gantry
gui.wmd.deck_console.sum: Arms %s (%s busy)   Depots %s: %s rounds   Gantries %s (%s on)
gui.wmd.deck_console.empty_wing: None of your craft is parked in range
gui.wmd.deck_console.tip_fuel: Send the service arm to refuel it
gui.wmd.deck_console.tip_fuel_out: No service arm has found a fuel point on it
gui.wmd.deck_console.tip_arm: Order the ammo depot to stock it
gui.wmd.deck_console.tip_fix: Start the repair gantry on it
gui.wmd.deck_console.tip_fix_out: It is not under a gantry's rails
message.wmd.ap.too_slow: Autopilot: too slow (near the stall speed)
message.wmd.ap.no_route: Autopilot: no waypoints on the route
message.wmd.ap.no_home: Autopilot: no home marked (HOME tab: drag along a runway on the map, or Mark here on the wheels)
message.wmd.ap.home_bad: Autopilot: that home mark is not valid
message.wmd.ap.home_short: Autopilot: a runway needs at least 40 blocks: drag longer
message.wmd.ap.home_unloaded: Autopilot: that spot is not loaded: mark a home closer by
message.wmd.ap.home_wheels: Autopilot: Mark here needs the craft standing on its wheels
message.wmd.ap.home_deck: Autopilot: on a deck put a landing beacon near you, then Mark here
message.wmd.ap.hold_here: Autopilot: holding this course, height and speed
gui.wmd.ap.title: Autopilot
gui.wmd.ap.set_now: Set to what the craft does now
gui.wmd.ap.hint_route: Click: waypoint · drag: move · right click: delete · map %s blocks
gui.wmd.ap.hint_orbit: Click: the centre to circle · map %s blocks
gui.wmd.ap.hint_map: Wheel: zoom · right drag: pan · map %s blocks
gui.wmd.ap.heading: Heading
gui.wmd.ap.no_wps: Click the map to add waypoints
gui.wmd.ap.home_how: Drag on the map from touchdown to the runway end
gui.wmd.ap.letgo: Lets go: stick, damage, stall, power
gui.wmd.ap.esc: Esc: back to the view. The craft keeps flying while you plan.
manual.wmd.autopilot.title: Autopilot
manual.wmd.autopilot.body: Tap the key left of 1: the autopilot screen. HOLD, ROUTE, ORBIT (turns to the guns), HOME (lands on the home you mark). Keeps %s over the ground, %s waypoints, checks a landing at %s. A flight key takes over.
tooltip.wmd.flight_deck: 3 x 2 x 3 flight deck: pilot and co-pilot side by side, open at the back to walk in from the hold. The co-pilot runs the radar and weapons. Right-click to sit, Z rings the bail-out bell
message.wmd.fdk.bail_out: BAIL OUT! BAIL OUT! Jump from the cargo ramp
manual.wmd.flight_deck.title: Flight deck cockpit
manual.wmd.flight_deck.body: 3 x 2 x 3, open at the back: walk in from the hold. Left seat flies, right seat fights. Yokes, pedals and levers follow the orders. %s FE/t avionics. Hold Z: bail-out bell. Key left of 1: the autopilot.
tooltip.wmd.chart_table: A lit chart of the sea round your ship: coast, seabed depths, your track, sonar contacts, surveyed fields.
tooltip.wmd.chart_table.use: Plan the helm autopilot here: HOLD, ROUTE, STATION. A route that would run aground cannot be engaged.
message.wmd.chart_table.gated: The chart table needs the 1.2 air battles content (Sable).
message.wmd.chart_table.status_ashore: lit, charting its surroundings (no autopilot ashore)
message.wmd.sp.no_craft: The helm is not on a ship.
gui.wmd.sp.title: Chart Table
gui.wmd.sp.station_how: Click the chart for the point.
gui.wmd.sp.check_chart: Plan only from the helm's owner.
manual.wmd.chart_table.title: Chart Table + Helm Autopilot
manual.wmd.chart_table.body: Right-click it, or tap the key left of 1 at the helm: HOLD, ROUTE (%s waypoints), STATION. Red legs run aground: no ENGAGE. Keel margin %s (sub) / %s (ship). A helm key takes over. %s FE/t.
tooltip.wmd.rf_sender: Takes up to %s FE/s from its busbar and beams it to the receivers on its channel (%s%% arrives, up to %s blocks)
tooltip.wmd.rf_receiver: Gives up to %s FE/s to its busbar from the senders on its channel (%s%% of what they send, up to %s blocks)
jei.wmd.info.rf_sender: Wireless power: takes up to %s FE/s from a busbar and beams it to every RF Power Receiver on the same channel. %s%% arrives; range %s blocks in the same dimension, through walls, ships included. EMP fields and enemy jammers cut the link.
jei.wmd.info.rf_receiver: Wireless power: pulls from the RF Power Senders on its channel and gives up to %s FE/s to its busbar. %s%% of what is sent arrives; range %s blocks. Only your own (or trusted) senders feed it.
gui.wmd.info.rf_rule: %s%% arrives; range %s blocks; set the channel on the antenna tab
gui.wmd.state.no_link: NO LINK: no partner on this channel in range
gui.wmd.state.jammed: JAMMED: EMP field or an enemy jammer
gui.wmd.rf.title: RF channel
gui.wmd.rf.label: Channel (0001-9999)
manual.wmd.rf_power.title: Wireless RF Power
manual.wmd.rf_power.body: Beams busbar power: %s FE/s in, receivers on its channel give %s FE/s out (%s%%). %s blocks, through walls; EMP and jammers cut it.
